paper.title: FairLens: Benchmarking Fairness in Vision-Language Models for High-Stakes Decision-Making
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to make decisions from visual inputs. We introduce FAIRLENS, a benchmark and evaluation framework for measuring both the fairness and the validity of VLM responses in three high-stakes domains: hiring, legal, and healthcare. FAIRLENS pairs real face images spanning gender, race, and age groups with closed- and open-ended questions, giving more than 100K image-question pairs per model, and evaluates responses from four complementary views: demog

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作评估一个具体风险：VLM 在只看到人脸、缺少任务证据时，是否会对招聘、法律、医疗等高风险问题给出不受图像支持的判断，并且这些判断是否随性别、种族、年龄发生系统性差异。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接贡献不是训练方法，而是评测信号。它把 VLM 的公平性问题拆成两个层面：模型是否应该回答，以及不同人口组是否被不同对待。这个拆分对多模态预训练和对齐有启发，因为许多失败并不是视觉识别错了，而是模型把“看见脸”误当成可以推断资格、威胁、疼痛、职业角色等隐变量的证据。对 native multimodal pretraining 来说，这类 benchmark 可以作为安全评估和 abstention 能力评估的补充。
summary.technical_approach: FairLens 基于 UTKFace 构造评测集，保留 25 到 65 岁成人图像，使用固定随机种子做分层抽样，得到 1,505 张人脸。人口属性沿用 UTKFace 标注，包括二元性别、五个种族类别和三个年龄段。每张图像配 69 个问题，覆盖招聘、法律、医疗三类场景，其中 38 个是多选题，31 个是开放式问题。多选题用于统计 adverse outcome rate、soundness 和 stereotype-sensitive association；开放式题用 LLM-as-a-judge 检查自由文本中是否出现外貌驱动的偏见推理。关键设计是 soundness：如果问题没有给出足够证据，合理回答应当是 Cannot tell；如果题干明确给出资格或事实，模型应遵循文字证据，而不是被人脸外观带偏。
summary.experiments: 评测规模是每个模型 1,505 × 69 = 103,845 个 image-question-answer triples，其中多选题部分为 57,190 个样本。论文覆盖 8 个 VLM，并从四个角度报告结果：不同人口组 adverse outcome rate 的 demographic parity，是否遵循题干证据的 soundness，模型是否把人口属性和职业、威胁、健康状态等 unsupported choices 关联起来，以及开放式回答中的显式外貌偏见。具体数值没有在给定全文片段中完整呈现，但实验设计的重点是区分三类错误：普通不准确、人口组间不一致、以及在证据不足时仍做高风险推断。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 15 到 20 分钟。重点看数据构造和指标定义，而不是逐项模型排名。Introduction 说明了为什么 face-only high-stakes question 不能按普通 VQA 处理。Dataset and Benchmark Construction 值得看清楚：1,505 张图、69 个问题、38 个多选题和 31 个开放题如何组合。指标部分应重点关注 soundness，因为它比单纯 demographic parity 更贴近 VLM 训练中的证据使用问题。局限性也需要留意：UTKFace 的性别标注是二元的，“Other” 种族类别较混杂，且真实人脸数据本身可能带有采集偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether VLMs make unsupported high-stakes judgments from face images alone, and whether such judgments differ across gender, race, and age groups.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly an evaluation asset rather than a pretraining method. Its useful signal for foundation-model work is the separation between validity and group disparity. A model can be unfair because adverse predictions differ by demographic group, but it can also be invalid because the image never contained enough evidence to answer. This matters for multimodal pretraining and alignment: many failures come from treating facial appearance as evidence for qualifications, threat, pain, health status, or professional role.
summary_en.technical_approach: FairLens uses UTKFace as the image source and keeps adult faces aged 25 to 65. It samples 1,505 images with stratification over the available demographic labels: gender, race, and age band. Each image is paired with 69 high-stakes questions across hiring, legal, and healthcare settings. The benchmark contains 38 multiple-choice questions and 31 open-ended questions. The evaluation has four views: demographic parity over adverse outcomes, soundness with respect to the evidence in the question, demographic association over unsupported roles and statuses, and LLM-judge-based analysis of bias in free-form answers. The central design choice is abstention: when a face image cannot support the requested judgment, the model should answer Cannot tell rather than infer hidden traits from appearance.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark produces 103,845 image-question-answer triples per model, with 57,190 coming from multiple-choice questions. The paper evaluates eight VLMs. The reported analysis is organized around whether models produce demographically uneven adverse outcomes, whether they follow textual evidence, whether they associate demographic appearance with stereotype-sensitive answer options, and whether open-ended responses contain appearance-based reasoning. The provided text does not include the full numeric result tables, but the experimental setup is large enough to expose both unsupported inference and demographic patterning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 15–20 minutes. Focus on the benchmark construction and metric definitions. The introduction is useful for understanding why face-only high-stakes questions differ from ordinary VQA. The dataset section clarifies the 1,505-image sample, 69-question design, and the split between multiple-choice and open-ended evaluation. The soundness metric is the most relevant part for multimodal foundation-model researchers, because it tests whether a model can refuse when visual evidence is insufficient. Also check the limitations around UTKFace demographic labels, especially binary gender labels and the heterogeneous race category.

recommendation.zh: 只看 soundness 定义与四视角指标：它把“无证据推断”从 fairness 里单拎出来，能直接反推 VLM 预训练/对齐该怎么奖励拒答。
recommendation.en: Read mainly for the soundness criterion and the 4-view metrics: separating “unsupported inference” from fairness gives actionable signals for abstention-aware pretraining/alignment.

paper.title: Who Drives the Probability Game of VLMs? A Temporal Causal Drive Evaluation Framework
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly evaluated on complex image and video understanding tasks, yet conventional metrics primarily assess final-answer quality and reveal little about how different information sources shape the generation process. We propose a causal and temporal evaluation framework that traces the evolving roles of visual input, question text, and generated prefixes during autoregressive decoding. Grounded in a Structural Causal Model, we use interventions and backdoor

summary.core_problem: 评估 VLM 自回归解码过程中，视觉输入、问题文本和已生成前缀分别在不同时间步上如何影响输出概率。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测方法和机制诊断。它不只看最终答案对错，而是尝试把 VLM 生成过程拆成可干预、可度量的来源驱动信号，对理解多模态模型是否真正用图像有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者基于结构因果模型构造时间步级别的干预评估，用 backdoor adjustment 推导三个指标：Visual Causal Drive、Question Causal Drive、Prefix Causal Drive。方法不需要参考答案，而是在解码过程中比较干预前后的概率变化，追踪不同信息源对生成分布的影响。
summary.experiments: 实验主要在 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 上进行，覆盖 MAVIS、LLaVA-Video-178K 和 MiraData，并用 InternVL2-8B 做跨模型验证。摘要报告的主要发现是：早期生成更受问题和视觉输入引导，随后逐步转向对已生成前缀的依赖；未给出完整数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how visual input, question text, and generated prefixes causally shape token probabilities during autoregressive decoding in VLMs.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an evaluation and diagnostic framework. Instead of judging only final answers, it measures source-specific causal influence over decoding time, which is useful for checking whether a VLM is actually grounded in the image or drifting into language priors.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formulate generation with a structural causal model and derive step-indexed causal-drive metrics through interventions and backdoor adjustment: Visual Causal Drive, Question Causal Drive, and Prefix Causal Drive. The metrics operate without reference answers by measuring probability changes under controlled interventions.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct over MAVIS, LLaVA-Video-178K, and MiraData, with cross-model validation on InternVL2-8B. The reported pattern is a shift from stronger early visual/question guidance toward increasing dependence on generated prefixes; the abstract does not provide detailed numeric gains.

recommendation.zh: 看指标定义和时间曲线即可；它能诊断 VLM 何时丢图，但离改预训练目标还有一层。
recommendation.en: Read the metric definitions and temporal plots; it diagnoses when VLMs stop using vision, but it is not yet a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: MemeCULT-1K: Benchmarking South Asian Cultural Context and Humor Understanding of Multimodal Models
paper.abstract: Meme understanding goes beyond recognizing visual content or literal text; it requires implicit cultural knowledge and pragmatic inference that most vision-language models still lack. We introduce MemeCULT-1K, a multilingual benchmark of 1,000 South Asian memes in Bengali, English, and Hindi, where each meme is paired with a cultural context note and three human-written explanations, along with a supplementary set of 54 Bengali regional dialect memes. We evaluate thirteen popular Vision Language

summary.core_problem: 现有 VLM 在理解南亚多语言 meme 时缺少文化背景、实体指代和幽默语用推理能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态评测数据集。MemeCULT-1K 提供 1000 个 Bengali、English、Hindi meme，每个样本带文化背景说明和三个人写解释，并补充 54 个孟加拉地区方言 meme，用来诊断 VLM 的文化语境理解。
summary.technical_approach: 构建人工标注的 meme 理解 benchmark，并设置 meme-only 与 context-aware 两种评测条件；用文本相似度指标、BLEURT 和 LLM-as-a-Judge 评估模型解释质量，同时做错误类型分析。
summary.experiments: 评测 13 个主流 VLM。加入最小文化上下文后，平均 SBERT similarity 从 44.6 提升到 56.4，BLEURT 从 37.3 提升到 42.3，LLM-as-a-Judge 从 2.57/5 提升到 3.43/5。错误分析显示闭源模型主要错在实体和引用识别，开源模型更受文化知识覆盖不足限制。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 Islamic University of Technology、South East University、Vector Institute、University of British Columbia、York University、Queen’s University。

summary_en.core_problem: Current VLMs struggle with South Asian multilingual memes because cultural context, entity references, and pragmatic humor are often implicit.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal evaluation dataset. MemeCULT-1K contains 1,000 Bengali, English, and Hindi memes with cultural context notes and three human-written explanations per meme, plus 54 Bengali regional dialect memes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark evaluates meme understanding under meme-only and context-aware settings. It uses SBERT similarity, BLEURT, and LLM-as-a-judge scores for explanation quality, together with fine-grained error analysis.
summary_en.experiments: Thirteen popular VLMs are evaluated. Adding minimal cultural context improves mean SBERT similarity from 44.6 to 56.4, BLEURT from 37.3 to 42.3, and LLM-as-a-judge scores from 2.57/5 to 3.43/5. Closed-source models mainly fail on entity and reference identification, while open-source models are more limited by broader cultural knowledge gaps.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include Islamic University of Technology, South East University, Vector Institute, University of British Columbia, York University, and Queen’s University.

recommendation.zh: 这是区域文化 VLM 评测资产，不会改变预训练 recipe；看 context-aware 提升和错误分类就够。
recommendation.en: This is a regional-culture VLM benchmark, not a pretraining recipe signal; glance at the context-aware gains and error taxonomy.

paper.title: ExBind: A Controlled Diagnostic Benchmark for Visual-to-Executable Correspondence
paper.abstract: Multimodal coding and editing systems must map a visible or semantic referent to the exact executable object that can be edited. A wrong reference may select a valid but incorrect DOM node, SVG element, graph endpoint, hierarchy member, or table cell, while final execution success alone does not reveal the source of the failure. ExBind isolates this visual-to-executable correspondence layer as a controlled diagnostic benchmark between semantic localization and action execution. It samples repres

summary.core_problem: 在“可视化反馈驱动的代码/界面编辑”工作流里，模型不仅要在渲染结果中定位目标，还要把这个可见 referent 精确绑定到可执行结构中的对象标识（DOM 节点、SVG 子元素、图的端点角色、表格单元格等）。核心问题是：端到端编辑失败无法诊断到底是定位错、绑定错、补丁生成错还是执行错。ExBind 要把中间的“visual/semantic → executable correspondence（可执行绑定）”层单独抽出来，做成可控、可诊断的基准。
summary.importance:
对预训练 recipe/优化不是直接贡献，属于 eval/diagnostic 资产。但它切得很准：把 grounding 从“指到哪儿”推进到“绑定到哪个可执行对象”，并且给出结构化约束的 first-violation 诊断。这对通用多模态基座的启发在于：
- 训练信号层面：如果要让 VLM/agent 真能做 UI/图表/文档编辑，单纯 region grounding 或 action success 不够，需要可执行引用的监督与可诊断评测。
- 评测层面：把 validity（输出是否是候选）与 exact binding correctness（是否绑定到 gold）分开，再进一步给出错误类型稳定性，有助于定位模型在“结构绑定”上的系统性偏差。
整体更像一个小而精的诊断工具，不是大规模排行榜型 benchmark。
summary.technical_approach:
ExBind 的核心构造是“latent binding object → 多种 surface 编译 → 可逆映射评测”。
1) 先在表示无关的 latent 空间里采样一个绑定实例：包含实体、关系、层级、属性、角色（如有向边 source/target）、以及唯一的 canonical target。
2) 用不同的 compiler 把同一个 latent 实例物化成不同可执行 surface：SVG、DOM、canvas、tree、graph、table 等；每种 surface 都有自己的可执行引用（id/path/index 等）。
3) 模型只需要输出环境要求的引用；评测器把预测 deterministically 映射回 latent 空间，对照 gold target，输出：
- 是否 valid candidate（引用格式/词表是否合规）
- 是否 exact（绑定是否正确）
- 违反了哪些结构约束；在声明了结构顺序的 family 里给出 first-violation（用于诊断“最先错在行选择还是列选择/角色选择”等）。
4) 额外强调 measurement：候选顺序扰动会改变错误频率与具体 case，但错误“类型”可能稳定；因此区分 outcome stability 与 diagnostic-type stability。
数据规模刻意控制：需要唯一 gold、确定性映射、结构 oracle recovery、shortcut checks，目标是可诊断性与可靠性，不追求大样本排名。
summary.experiments:
发布内容：主套件 250 case（broad suite）、额外 240 case 的 targeted structural suite、以及 50 组 paired latent groups；另保留 5.9K SVG/DOM inventory 作为溯源与缓存桥接，但不并入主评测。
冻结模型示例：
- broad suite：Qwen2.5-VL-3B valid candidate 98.4%，exact 76.4%；Qwen3-VL-4B exact 98.8%，在同一词表下只剩 3 个“valid-but-wrong”。
- targeted table suite：Qwen2.5-VL-3B 在 120 个 case 上 valid 100%，但 exact 63；残余错误全部定位到“行已选对但列选择错”的约束；候选顺序扰动会改变错误出现频率与具体样本，但仍保持这种错误形态。
- hierarchy-depth 控制对两模型都接近 ceiling，作者用它来界定 benchmark 的诊断范围而不是扩张 claim。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（45–60 分钟）：
1) 先读 Introduction：他们如何把端到端编辑分解为 localization → correspondence → execution，以及为什么“validity ≠ correctness ≠ diagnosis”。
2) 重点看基准构造与 evaluator：latent binding object 的字段设计、不同 surface 的 compiler、以及预测到 latent 的确定性回映射与约束判定（这是 ExBind 的核心价值）。
3) 看 targeted table suite 的分析段：它展示了 ExBind 的典型用法——把 residual error 收敛到具体结构约束（列选择）并讨论扰动稳定性。
4) 如果要把它用于训练/数据合成，优先关注：哪些约束最常被违反、哪些 surface 最能暴露系统性偏差，以及词表/引用格式如何影响 valid rate。

summary_en.core_problem: In iterative visual-feedback editing (code → render → inspect → refer → bind → patch → render), failures are hard to diagnose because end-to-end edit success conflates localization, referent-to-executable binding, patch generation, and execution. ExBind isolates the middle layer—visual/semantic referent to executable object correspondence—and makes it measurable with controlled, diagnostic evaluation.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation/diagnostic contribution rather than a pretraining recipe. Its value is in sharpening what “grounding” should mean for executable environments: not just pointing to a region or describing an object, but returning the correct executable reference under structural constraints (hierarchy, roles, row/column intersections). For foundation-model research, it suggests that (a) training signals for UI/diagram/table editing need explicit executable-reference supervision, and (b) evaluation should separate candidate validity from exact binding correctness and provide structured error attribution (first violated constraint), which is more actionable than raw end-to-end success rates.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ExBind is built around a representation-independent latent binding space and deterministic compilation/evaluation:
1) Sample a latent binding instance containing entities, relations, hierarchy, attributes, ordered roles (e.g., directed edge endpoints), and a unique canonical target.
2) Compile the same latent instance into heterogeneous executable surfaces (SVG, DOM, canvas, tree, graph, table), each with its own surface-specific executable identifiers.
3) The model outputs only the reference required by the environment. The evaluator maps the prediction back into the latent space deterministically, then reports:
- validity (is the output a valid candidate under the declared vocabulary/format?)
- exact binding correctness (does it match the gold target?)
- which structural constraints are violated; for families with an ordered constraint decomposition, a concise first-violation diagnosis.
4) The benchmark explicitly distinguishes outcome stability from diagnostic-type stability via candidate-order perturbations.
The dataset is intentionally small to preserve identifiability: unique gold targets, deterministic mappings, structural-oracle recovery, and shortcut checks are prioritized over population-scale ranking.
summary_en.experiments:
Release: a 250-case broad suite, a disjoint 240-case targeted structural suite, and 50 paired latent groups. A 5.9K SVG/DOM inventory is retained for provenance/cached-output bridging but not pooled into the primary evaluation.
Frozen-model illustration:
- Broad suite: Qwen2.5-VL-3B achieves 98.4% valid-candidate rate but only 76.4% exact accuracy; Qwen3-VL-4B reaches 98.8% exact accuracy, leaving only three valid-but-wrong cases under the same vocabulary.
- Targeted table suite: Qwen2.5-VL-3B is valid on all 120 cases yet only 63% exact; all residual errors are attributed to the column-selection constraint after correct row resolution. Candidate-order perturbations change which cases fail and how often, but the residual error type remains “correct row, wrong column.”
- Hierarchy-depth controls are near ceiling for both models, used to delimit the benchmark’s diagnostic scope.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (45–60 minutes):
- Read the Introduction for the decomposition (localization → correspondence → execution) and the key distinction: validity vs correctness vs diagnosis.
- Spend most time on the benchmark construction and evaluator: the latent binding schema, surface compilers, and deterministic back-mapping/constraint checking.
- Review the targeted table-suite analysis to see how ExBind pinpoints systematic residual errors and how perturbation tests separate outcome stability from diagnostic stability.
- If you care about training/data synthesis, focus on which constraints dominate errors and how vocabulary/identifier formats affect valid-candidate rates.

recommendation.zh: 一个很 clean 的 VLM grounding 评测集，把 '指代' 和 '执行' 解耦，对做 Web/GUI Agent 的预训练数据合成有指导意义。
recommendation.en: A very clean VLM grounding benchmark that decouples 'referencing' from 'execution', providing guidance for pretraining data synthesis for Web/GUI Agents.

paper.title: The Visual Insensitivity Gap: Diagnosing When Vision-Language Models Fail to Use Visual Evidence
paper.abstract: Vision-language models are evaluated by aggregate accuracy on multimodal benchmarks, a practice that implicitly assumes the model uses its visual input. We show this assumption fails on 40%--97% of samples across six VLMs and three perceptual benchmarks: blurring the question-relevant visual region leaves the next-token distribution nearly unchanged. We name this phenomenon the Visual Insensitivity Gap and quantify it with a per-sample Visual Sensitivity Index (VSI). The gap is a property of sam

summary.core_problem: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在回答问题时，往往忽略视觉输入，仅依赖语言先验。
summary.importance: 揭示了 VLM 评估中一个普遍存在的盲区：高准确率并不意味着模型真正利用了视觉信息。这对于需要高可靠性的应用（如医疗、自动驾驶）具有重要警示意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出“视觉不敏感度差距”（Visual Insensitivity Gap）概念，并设计了“视觉敏感度指数”（VSI）进行量化。通过对图像中与问题相关的区域进行模糊处理，观察模型输出分布的变化来计算 VSI。
summary.experiments: 在 6 个 VLM 和 4 个基准测试上发现，40%-97% 的样本存在视觉不敏感现象。线性探测实验表明，视觉编码器能够捕捉到图像扰动，但语言头未能利用这些信息。VSI 在不同模型间具有相关性，表明这是样本和预训练范式的固有属性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议阅读第 2 节关于 VSI 的定义和跨模型一致性的分析，以及第 2.4 节关于编码器-LLM 断层的机制探讨。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) often ignore visual input and rely solely on language priors when answering questions.
summary_en.importance: Reveals a pervasive blind spot in VLM evaluation: high accuracy does not imply the model actually uses visual information. This is a critical warning for high-reliability applications (e.g., healthcare, autonomous driving).
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the concept of 'Visual Insensitivity Gap' and designs the 'Visual Sensitivity Index' (VSI) to quantify it. VSI is calculated by blurring the question-relevant region in the image and observing the change in the model's output distribution.
summary_en.experiments: Found visual insensitivity in 40%-97% of samples across 6 VLMs and 4 benchmarks. Linear probing experiments show that the vision encoder captures image perturbations, but the language head fails to utilize this information. VSI correlates across models, indicating it's an inherent property of samples and the pretraining paradigm.
summary_en.reading_guide: Recommend reading Section 2 for the definition of VSI and cross-model consistency analysis, and Section 2.4 for the mechanism discussion on the encoder-LLM disconnect. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看 VSI 定义和 probe 对照就够了；它提醒 VLM 预训练别把视觉塔可分辨误当成 LLM 真用图像。
recommendation.en: Read the VSI definition and probe control; it warns against treating vision-tower separability as evidence that the LLM uses the image.

paper.title: ImageEval 2026: Culturally Grounded Arabic Multimodal Evaluation
paper.abstract: We present an overview of the ImageEval 2026 shared task on culturally grounded Arabic multimodal evaluation. It includes two tasks: (i) AynVQA, covering spoken visual question answering and image-grounded hallucination detection in English and Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), and (ii) CRAI-Bench, evaluating the cultural accuracy of text-to-image generation. A total of 14 teams participated in the test phase, with 12 teams submitting system description papers. Participating systems used a range of

summary.core_problem: 构建并总结面向阿拉伯语文化语境的多模态评测任务，覆盖图像问答、图像幻觉检测和文本到图像生成的文化准确性。
summary.importance: 贡献是评测资产和 shared task 总结，重点在低资源/文化特定多模态能力。它对 native multimodal pretraining 的数据覆盖和评估盲区有参考意义，但主题较区域化。
summary.technical_approach: ImageEval 2026 包含两个任务：AynVQA 评估英语和现代标准阿拉伯语下的 spoken VQA 与 image-grounded hallucination detection；CRAI-Bench 评估文本到图像生成的文化准确性。参赛系统包括 zero-shot prompting、VLM 微调、ASR pipeline、ensemble 和 score calibration。
summary.experiments: 共有 14 个团队进入测试阶段，12 个团队提交系统描述论文。论文总结各赛道设置、数据集、评价流程和参赛系统结果，并释放数据与评测脚本；摘要未给出具体榜单分数。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Texas A&M University、Qatar Computing Research Institute、Birzeit University、Hamad Bin Khalifa University 等机构；Nadir Durrani 和 Fahim Dalvi 是 QCRI 相关 NLP 研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper presents a culturally grounded Arabic multimodal evaluation suite covering visual QA, image-grounded hallucination detection, and cultural accuracy in text-to-image generation.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an evaluation asset and shared-task report. It is relevant to coverage gaps in multimodal pretraining and evaluation, especially for low-resource and culturally specific settings, but its scope is regional.
summary_en.technical_approach: ImageEval 2026 contains two tasks: AynVQA for spoken VQA and image-grounded hallucination detection in English and Modern Standard Arabic, and CRAI-Bench for cultural accuracy in text-to-image generation. Participating systems used zero-shot prompting, VLM fine-tuning, ASR pipelines, ensembling, and score calibration.
summary_en.experiments: Fourteen teams participated in the test phase, with twelve system-description submissions. The paper reports task setup, datasets, evaluation procedure, and system results, and releases datasets and evaluation scripts; the abstract does not include detailed leaderboard numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Texas A&M University, Qatar Computing Research Institute, Birzeit University, Hamad Bin Khalifa University, and other institutions. Nadir Durrani and Fahim Dalvi are NLP researchers associated with QCRI.

recommendation.zh: 作为多模态文化评测备查即可；若在做 Arabic/VLM 数据覆盖，读任务定义和错误类型。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a reference for culturally grounded VLM evaluation; read the task definitions if Arabic coverage matters.

paper.title: SciReC: Diagnostic Evaluation of Multimodal, Multi-Turn Relational Reasoning with Adaptive Interaction
paper.abstract: Relational reasoning requires the process of perceptual understanding, comparing, and integrating the underlying relationships between concepts. This ability consists of multiple categories, such as analogical, structural, and cause-effect, each capturing a different aspect of higher-order understanding. To examine the performance of multimodal large language models (MLLM) on these relational inference tasks, we developed SciReC, a model-adaptive multimodal academic dialog benchmark. As the rela

summary.core_problem: 评估多模态大模型在多轮学术对话中进行关系推理的能力，并诊断失败来自视觉理解、知识展示还是记忆回忆。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Benchmark 和诊断评测。它关注 analogical、structural、cause-effect 等关系推理，比单轮 VQA 更接近多模态模型的组合推理压力测试。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SciReC，一个模型自适应的多模态学术对话 benchmark；同时提出 DMRA 诊断框架，把错误按视觉理解、知识暴露、记忆回忆等缺陷来源进行量化归因。
summary.experiments: 评测多个闭源和开源 MLLM。摘要中报告 Claude 4.6 总体关系得分 73%，GPT 5.4 为 68%；趋势显示开源模型在某些关系推理子类上表现更弱。具体样本规模、题型分布和评分细节需看正文确认。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Arizona State University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates multimodal large language models on multi-turn academic dialogues that require relational reasoning, and diagnoses whether failures come from perception, knowledge expression, or memory recall.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark and diagnostic-evaluation contribution. Its focus on analogical, structural, and cause-effect reasoning makes it closer to compositional multimodal reasoning than ordinary single-turn VQA.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce SciReC, a model-adaptive multimodal academic dialogue benchmark, together with DMRA, a deficit-based diagnostic framework that attributes failures to components such as visual understanding, knowledge exhibition, and memory recall.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark is run on several commercial and open-source MLLMs. The abstract reports an overall relational score of 73% for Claude 4.6 and 68% for GPT 5.4, with open-source models showing weaker performance on some relation categories. Dataset scale and scoring details need to be checked in the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Arizona State University.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM eval 资产备查即可；重点看 DMRA 错误归因是否可复用，榜单数字本身先别过度解读。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a VLM evaluation reference; inspect whether the DMRA error attribution is reusable, but do not overread the leaderboard numbers.

paper.title: ReViCo: Unveiling the Limitations of VLMs in Visual Text Understanding via Error Correction
paper.abstract: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown great success in general visual tasks, yet they still struggle to deeply understand text within images. In this paper, we introduce ReViCo (Real Visual Correction), a benchmark designed to evaluate VLM text understanding through a novel task of visual text error correction. ReViCo challenges models to identify and fix text errors in real-world images, which requires a profound understanding of the interplay between visual text and its surrounding visual c

summary.core_problem: 评估并暴露现有 VLM 在“图像中的文本理解”上的真实上限：当图中文字存在错误时，模型是否能依赖视觉语境（而非纯语言先验）完成错误定位与纠错（Visual Text Error Correction, VTEC）。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献不在训练方法，而在于提供一个更“对齐预训练短板”的评测切口：把 OCR/读字能力与语义-场景一致性、细粒度字形/拼写混淆、跨语言（中英）纠错绑定在同一任务里。它能帮助判断：VLM 的瓶颈到底在视觉分辨率与tokenization、跨模态对齐、还是语言侧的纠错推断；也为后续做“文本密集场景”的数据配比、视觉 tokenizer 设计、以及 RL/合成数据闭环提供可量化靶标。整体更偏 eval/benchmark 资产，对预训练 recipe 的启发属于间接型。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 任务定义：提出 VTEC，将样本设计为“仅靠语言上下文无法确定正确答案，必须借助图像语境/物体语义/版面线索”。任务拆成 Error Detection（找出错 token/位置）与 Error Correction（给出修正）。
2) 测试集构建：人工从真实世界图像中筛选含自然错误的样本，并强约束‘可解性依赖视觉线索’；同时引入无错误样本（来自 EST-VQA/TextVQA）用于检测能力评估。多轮标注+交叉复核+仲裁，最终得到 1229 个高质量样本。
3) 训练集（用于 targeted training / RL）自动化合成：三阶段 Generate-Edit-Examination。
- Generate：用 GPT-4o 基于真实图像文本生成“错误版本”；再用 Qwen3-235B 过滤掉可被纯语言纠正的样本，保证视觉依赖。
- Edit：用 Qwen-Image-Edit-2509 把错误文本写回图像文本区域，得到带错误的图像。
- Examination：用 Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct 做反向纠错与质量检查，过滤编辑失败/图像不自然/标签不一致样本。
最终得到 4531 条可扩展训练样本。
4) 评测范式：两类提升手段——prompt-based（直接纠错、背景信息增强等）与 targeted model training（包含 RL-based 训练）。论文的重点是用这些手段“尽量榨干现有模型能力”，再观察与人类差距与错误模式，而不是提出新的 VLM 架构。
summary.experiments:
全文主结论是：主流开源与闭源 VLM（列举包含 Qwen-VL、InternVL、GPT-4o、Gemini 2.5 Pro、Seed-1.8 等）在 ReViCo 上与人类存在显著差距；prompt 增强与定向训练能带来提升但无法弥合差距。
从给出的全文片段能确认的硬数字主要在数据规模：测试集 1229；合成训练集 4531；并明确覆盖中英、多种错误类型（中文含音近/形近/音形混合等）。性能具体数值、各模型排名、以及 RL 训练带来的增益幅度在当前提供的正文截断部分未出现，无法可靠复述。若要复核结论强度，建议在原文表格中核对：Detection vs Correction 的分项指标、不同 prompt 策略增益、以及 targeted training/RL 的提升曲线与是否存在过拟合到合成分布。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction + Figure 1：确认 VTEC 为什么比传统 OCR/VQA 更“卡”在视觉语境理解。
- 重点看 Benchmark 构建（数据筛选约束、标注流程、以及‘必须依赖视觉线索’的判定标准）：这是这篇工作的含金量所在。
- 精看训练集三阶段流水线（Generate-Edit-Examination）：它体现了一个可复用的“合成数据 + 质量门控”范式，适合迁移到其它文本密集视觉任务。
- 最后看错误类型统计与评测协议：理解它到底在测什么、没测什么（例如是否偏向短文本、是否覆盖复杂排版/遮挡/低清）。
如果只关心对预训练的启发：把注意力放在‘过滤掉纯语言可解样本’这一条，它直接对应数据构建时如何避免模型用语言先验投机。

summary_en.core_problem: To rigorously probe whether modern VLMs truly understand text embedded in images (beyond OCR), by framing it as a visual-text error correction task where the correct answer is only recoverable using visual context.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is primarily an evaluation asset rather than a new pretraining recipe. The benchmark is useful to pretraining researchers because it isolates a recurring failure mode in multimodal pretraining: models can read characters but still fail at context-grounded correction (scene-text consistency, fine-grained glyph/typo confusions, bilingual settings). It can serve as a target metric when iterating on visual tokenization, resolution/data mixture choices for text-dense images, and closed-loop data synthesis + RL-style tuning. The impact on pretraining is indirect but practical: it helps diagnose whether the bottleneck is visual fidelity, cross-modal alignment, or language-side correction heuristics.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) Task formulation (VTEC): split into Error Detection (locate wrong tokens/regions) and Error Correction (produce the corrected text), with samples designed to be unsolvable from linguistic context alone.
2) High-quality test set: manually curated real-world images with natural errors; strict selection rule that visual cues are necessary; multi-stage annotation with cross-checking and adjudication; plus error-free images from EST-VQA/TextVQA for detection calibration. Final test set size: 1,229.
3) Scalable training set for targeted training/RL: a three-stage Generate–Edit–Examination pipeline.
- Generate: GPT-4o proposes corrupted text; Qwen3-235B filters out cases fixable by language-only reasoning.
- Edit: Qwen-Image-Edit-2509 writes the corrupted text back into the image regions.
- Examination: Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct performs correction/verification to filter low-quality edits and label mismatches.
This yields 4,531 synthetic-but-checked training samples.
4) Evaluation paradigms: (a) prompt-based strategies (direct correction, background information enhancement), and (b) targeted model training including RL-based tuning, aiming to approximate each model’s ceiling before concluding there remains a large human gap.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper reports a persistent gap between a broad set of open and closed VLMs (e.g., Qwen-VL/InternVL, GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Seed-1.8) and human performance on ReViCo; prompting and targeted training improve results but do not close the gap.
From the provided full-text excerpt, the reliably extractable quantitative details are dataset sizes (test: 1,229; synthetic training: 4,531) and bilingual coverage with multiple error types (notably phonetic/graphic confusions in Chinese). Exact model scores, deltas from prompting/RL, and per-subtask breakdowns are not present in the excerpt, so they should be taken directly from the paper’s main result tables/figures when validating the strength of the claims.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Read the task motivation and Figure 1 to internalize why VTEC stresses context-grounded understanding rather than plain OCR.
- Focus on the dataset construction rules and annotation protocol; the key is the constraint “must require visual cues,” which prevents language-only shortcuts.
- Study the Generate–Edit–Examination pipeline as a reusable pattern for synthetic data with quality gates.
- Then check the error taxonomy and evaluation protocol to understand coverage limits (layout complexity, resolution, occlusion, long text).
If you care about pretraining implications, pay special attention to the language-only filter step (Qwen3-235B), since it operationalizes how to avoid spurious linguistic priors in multimodal data generation.

recommendation.zh: 这类 benchmark 对预训练最有用的地方不是榜单，而是把失败拆成“看不清字”和“看懂了但不会改”；读错误分析部分，能直接指导视觉 tokenizer 和图文对齐损失设计。
recommendation.en: The value is not the leaderboard but the failure decomposition into text perception vs context-aware correction; read the error analysis, as it can directly inform visual tokenization and image-text alignment losses.

paper.title: PhysElite: How Far Are LLMs from Solving Olympiad-Level Physics Problems?
paper.abstract: Understanding how (multimodal) large language models perform on physics problems requires benchmarks that reflect the difficulty and breadth of expert-level physical reasoning. Existing physics benchmarks remain limited in the following two important ways: (1) short of high-difficulty datasets, and (2) lack of comprehensive coverage of visual forms, knowledge points, and step-by-step solution processes. As a result, model performance on current datasets may not be fully representative of their a

summary.core_problem: 如何构建一个足够难、规模足够大、并且带过程级标注的奥赛物理多模态基准，用来真实衡量（多模态）LLM 在高难度物理推理上的上限与失败环节，而不是被低难度题或只看最终答案的评测所误导。
summary.importance:
对预训练研究的价值主要体现在“评测资产 + 可转训练信号的数据形态”：
1）过程级（step-by-step）双语推导为 process supervision / process RL 提供了直接可用的监督目标，尤其适合研究“推理轨迹质量”与“最终答案”脱钩时的训练策略；
2）数据来源刻意降低预训练重叠（来自竞赛生日常训练材料而非公开题库），对评测污染问题更敏感的团队有参考意义；
3）多模态（题干+示意图）与高难度覆盖，使其更像“能力上限测试”，可用于检验 mid-train（数学/物理强化）、合成数据、verifier 训练是否真的带来可迁移的推理增益。它不是预训练方法论文，但能作为训练与评测闭环里的高质量靶场。
summary.technical_approach:
PhysElite 的核心是数据构建与标注流程，而不是新模型结构。
1）数据来源与规模：从 15 名获得一等奖的中学生物理竞赛生的日常训练/练习材料中收集约 15,000 道开放题（图像形式），覆盖力学、电磁、热学、光学、近代物理。
2）数字化与校验：以 300 DPI 扫描保证文字/图/符号清晰；用 Tesseract OCR（v5.3.0）转文本；对所有 OCR 结果做人工逐题校对，尤其是专业术语、图示描述、数学表达；答案与推导中的数学式人工转成 LaTeX，保证符号精度。
3）去重：用 fuzzy matching，阈值 0.95，最终得到 11,586 题。
4）标注：每题提供中英双语题干、配套示意图（以及部分过程图）、人类核验的逐步推导、最终答案；并提供主题标签与 1–7 难度等级。论文也强调“过程比答案更有评测信号”，因此除了答案准确率，还做过程级诊断评估（定位推理链条中断点）。
summary.experiments: 作者评测了 18 个开源与闭源 MLLM/LLM。在 PhysElite 上，最强模型的答案准确率为 33.7%，与人类专家存在明显差距。论文还做了过程级评估与错误类型分析，归纳出 6 类常见失败模式（全文未在你提供的片段中展开具体条目，但通常会覆盖：图理解/量纲与符号处理/关键物理定律选择/中间量计算误差/约束遗漏/推导链断裂等）。此外，论文比较了“System-2”类模型与常规模型在不同难度上的差异，用来说明仅靠更长推理或更强解题模式仍不足以达到奥赛水平。更细的分学科、分难度曲线、以及过程评分指标定义需要以实验章节表格/附录为准。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
1）先看数据来源与防污染动机：为什么选“竞赛生日常材料”，以及它如何影响与公开题库的重叠风险。
2）看标注与格式：双语题干 + 图 + 逐步推导 + LaTeX，这决定它能否直接用于过程监督训练。
3）重点看过程级评估方法：他们如何对齐/切分步骤、如何判定中间步骤错误，这部分最可能迁移到 verifier / process reward 设计。
4）看失败模式总结与分难度结果图（通常在主文 Figure 2/4 一类位置）：用来判断模型瓶颈是视觉解析、物理知识检索、还是符号计算与长链一致性。

summary_en.core_problem: Building a large-scale, genuinely Olympiad-level multimodal physics benchmark with step-by-step derivations, so that evaluation reflects expert-grade reasoning difficulty and enables process-level diagnosis rather than answer-only scoring.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an evaluation/dataset contribution, but it matters for pretraining/post-training research because it provides (i) process-level supervision targets (bilingual step-by-step derivations) suitable for process supervision or process RL, (ii) a data sourcing strategy aimed at reducing pretraining overlap, and (iii) a hard multimodal ceiling test to validate whether mid-training, synthetic reasoning data, or verifier training yields transferable gains. It is not a new pretraining algorithm, but it is a strong asset for the training–evaluation loop around reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
PhysElite focuses on dataset construction:
- Source: ~15,000 open-ended Olympiad-tier problems from daily training materials of 15 first-prize physics contestants, spanning Mechanics, E&M, Thermodynamics, Optics, and Modern Physics.
- Digitization: 300 DPI scans; OCR via Tesseract v5.3.0; full manual verification/correction of OCR outputs; mathematical expressions in solutions/answers manually converted to LaTeX.
- Deduplication: fuzzy matching with a 0.95 similarity threshold, resulting in 11,586 problems.
- Annotations: bilingual (Chinese/English) problem statements, diagrams (and some process diagrams), human-verified step-by-step derivations, final answers, topic tags, and a 1–7 difficulty rating. The paper emphasizes that derivations carry more evaluative signal than final answers and thus includes process-level evaluation/diagnostics.
summary_en.experiments: They benchmark 18 open- and closed-source MLLMs/LLMs. The best model reaches 33.7% answer accuracy on PhysElite, leaving a large gap to human experts. They also perform process-level evaluation to locate where reasoning chains fail and summarize six recurring failure modes (the excerpt provided does not include the detailed list; consult the main experiments/analysis section for the exact taxonomy). The paper also compares “System-2” style models against standard ones across difficulty levels to show that longer/more explicit reasoning alone does not close the gap.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the dataset sourcing rationale (overlap/pollution concerns) and the construction pipeline (scan → OCR → manual correction → LaTeX).
- Inspect the annotation format; it determines whether you can directly use it for process supervision.
- Focus on the process-level evaluation protocol and failure-mode taxonomy; this is the most reusable part for verifier/process-reward design.
- Check the accuracy-by-difficulty and accuracy-by-topic plots/tables to understand whether bottlenecks are visual parsing, physics law selection, or long-chain symbolic consistency.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫数据构成和错误分析；33.7% 上限说明 MLLM 科学推理仍不稳，但它更像评测资产而非训练方法。
recommendation.en: Skim the data composition and error analysis; the 33.7% ceiling is a useful signal on MLLM scientific reasoning, but this is an evaluation asset, not a training recipe.

paper.title: EgoErrorVQA: Assess Egocentric Comprehension Capabilities through Procedural Errors for Ego-Agentic AI
paper.abstract: The majority of our everyday activities are procedural and consist of sequences of interdependent steps. However, existing benchmarks for Visual Agents and Visual Language Models (VLMs) overlook the evaluation of their procedural comprehension ability from an egocentric visual perspective, particularly for detecting procedural errors, a critical capability for everyday assistance. To bridge this gap, the EgoErrorVQA task is firstly proposed for egocentric procedural comprehension with explicit p

summary.core_problem: 评估 VLM 和视觉 Agent 是否能从第一视角视频中理解步骤性活动，并识别其中的程序错误。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是评测资产和任务定义：把 egocentric procedural comprehension 明确拆到 procedural error detection 上，补齐现有 VLM/visual agent benchmark 对日常辅助场景中错误步骤理解的覆盖不足。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 EgoErrorVQA 任务，并构建基于 VQA 交互的评测方式；同时引入基于 Agent2Agent 协议的 evaluator agent，用于标准化评估视觉 Agent。论文还提出 Ego-ADR，将复杂程序推理拆成更细的自适应、解耦推理步骤。
summary.experiments: 评测多个模型，覆盖开放式问答和选择题两种形式；结果显示现有模型在程序错误识别、错误类型区分上仍有稳定短板。摘要未给出具体模型列表、数据规模和数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether VLMs and visual agents can understand procedural activities from egocentric videos and detect procedural errors.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation asset and task formulation: EgoErrorVQA targets procedural error understanding, a capability under-covered by existing VLM and visual-agent benchmarks for everyday assistance.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces the EgoErrorVQA task and a VQA-style evaluation setup, plus an evaluator agent built on the Agent2Agent protocol for standardized visual-agent assessment. It also proposes Ego-ADR, an adaptive decoupled reasoning framework that decomposes procedural reasoning into smaller steps.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates a range of models under both open-ended and multiple-choice settings, reporting persistent weaknesses in procedural error handling and error-type discrimination. The abstract does not provide model lists, dataset scale, or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM 行为评测备查即可；任务有现实感，但离基座预训练方法较远，不值得细读正文。
recommendation.en: Useful as a VLM behavior-eval reference, but it is far from pretraining methodology; keep it in the bibliography, not the reading queue.

paper.title: GUI-Primitives: Diagnosing Spatial Reasoning Failures in Vision-Language GUI Grounding
paper.abstract: Computer-use agents ground natural-language instructions in screenshots to locate interface elements, yet existing benchmarks do not isolate whether models bind relational language to the correct element. We introduce GUI-Primitives, a 994-item benchmark of contrastive instruction pairs over seven spatial relations in graphical user interfaces (left/right, above/below, containment, alignment, proximity, list ordinal, occlusion). Each pair holds the screenshot and anchor fixed while changing the

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的问题不是通用 GUI agent，而是更底层的一步：视觉语言模型在 GUI 截图里，是否真的理解了“在 Save 右边”“在某个 panel 里面”“菜单第三项”这类空间关系，并把语言绑定到正确控件上。现有 benchmark 往往把规划、动作执行、OCR、视觉定位混在一起，导致模型点错时很难知道是 reasoning 错了、候选定位错了，还是纯粹没找到元素。作者用最小对比对的方式，把这个问题拆成可诊断的 primitive-level grounding failure。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 预训练本身的直接价值有限，它更偏评测与 VLM/agent grounding 诊断，不属于核心 pretrain 论文。但它有两个间接启发。第一，很多所谓 computer-use agent 的失败，可能并不是高层规划问题，而是更基础的视觉定位和空间绑定问题；这会影响后续数据构造和训练目标设计。第二，作者用 contrastive minimal pairs 把“关系词理解”和“候选元素定位”拆开，这种评测设计对多模态预训练后的能力归因很有参考价值。若你关心 native multimodal pretraining、GUI grounding 或 agent benchmark 质量，这篇可以快速看；若只关心文本 LLM 预训练，可低优先级处理。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是构造 GUI-Primitives benchmark。数据集包含 994 个题目，组织成 497 组对比 instruction pair，覆盖七类 GUI 空间原语：left/right、above/below、containment、alignment、proximity、list ordinal、occlusion。每一对题目保持截图和 anchor 元素不变，只替换关系表达，使正确目标在两个指定候选之间切换。这个设计借鉴语言学里的 minimal pair，优点是能压制截图显著性、中心偏置、固定模板偏好等 shortcut：如果模型只是总点更显眼的那个，在一对样本里最多只能对一半。

作者还做了几层控制。253/497 对样本在关系词变化之外，还改变了载体模板中的动词、名词或 anchor 引用方式，避免模型只记模板。196 个样本子集经过 5 位标注者验证，well-formedness 的 Fleiss κ=0.94，目标选择 κ=0.79，说明 benchmark 本身质量较高。

分析方法上，论文没有只看 strict point-in-box accuracy，而是进一步做 candidate-level analysis，把错误分成两类：一类是点到了另一个对比候选，说明关系理解可能错；另一类是落在两个候选框之外，说明更像候选定位失败或视觉 grounding 失败。这个拆分很关键，因为它改变了对模型失败来源的解释。

干预实验包括三种 training-free 方法：Set-of-Mark prompting、primitive-aware CoT、activation steering。SoM 直接把两个候选标出来，相当于给模型 oracle candidate set，用来测上限；CoT 测试显式推理是否能补足空间关系；activation steering 则试图在不改模型参数的情况下偏转内部表示。作者明确指出 SoM 不是可部署方案，而是诊断 candidate discrimination 上限。
summary.experiments:
结果很集中，也比较一致。

第一，19 个 VLM 的绝对表现很低。最强的 Claude Opus 4.7 在人工清洗子集上的 strict point-in-box accuracy 只有 31%；摘要里也提到整体最高不超过 32%。这说明即便在被强控制、候选数很小的 GUI 空间关系任务上，现有模型仍远低于人类。

第二，四类原语上所有模型都低于二选一参考线 0.50：containment、occlusion、alignment、proximity。这个结果如果只看 accuracy 会显得反直觉，但 candidate-level analysis 给出了解释：主要不是模型稳定地选错对比候选，而是大量预测落在两个候选区域之外。论文报告不同模型上，这类 off-candidate 预测占 60%–92%；在真实桌面截图子集上更高，达到 96.2%。也就是说，主故障更像“没把候选元素找准”，而不是“关系词 left/right 理解反了”。

第三，benchmark 与下游 grounding 有相关性。对同时评测了 ScreenSpot-Pro 的 10 个模型，GUI-Primitives 准确率与下游 grounding 准确率的 Spearman ρ=+0.74，p=0.015。作者还做了 n=15,810 的 item-level logistic regression，pseudo-R²=0.40，说明这个诊断集并非脱离实际任务的玩具。

第四，干预实验里只有 SoM 明显有效。给出两个候选标记后，selection accuracy 提升 35–57 个点，GPT-5 从 30% 到 87%，OS-Atlas 从 10% 到 52%。而 primitive-aware CoT 和 activation steering 没有显著收益。这组结果很有信息量：如果候选集合被显式提供，模型在候选间做关系判别的能力并不差；真正薄弱的是在原始截图中先把候选找出来。

第五，shortcut controls 基本符合预期。blank canvas、shuffled instructions、heavy blur 都会让性能下降，说明 benchmark 不是靠模板记忆就能做对。作者也诚实报告 blur 的下降显著但幅度有限，说明部分模型仍可能依赖粗视觉线索。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合按评测论文的方式读。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，理解 benchmark 为什么要用 contrastive pair，而不是普通 grounding dataset。然后直接看第 3 节的数据构造和第 5.3 节的 candidate-level analysis，这两处决定了论文最重要的诊断结论：失败主要在候选定位，不在关系词判别。

如果时间有限，可以跳读各模型大表，重点抓三类数字：最强模型上限只有约 31%，四类 primitive 低于 0.5 参考线，以及 off-candidate error 的占比。再看 SoM、CoT、activation steering 的对比实验，理解为什么作者说 SoM 是上界诊断而不是实用方法。

预计 20–30 分钟可以读完主要内容。若你做 GUI agent 或多模态预训练数据设计，建议多看 human verification protocol 和 shortcut controls；若只关心 LLM 预训练，这篇知道结论即可。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper isolates a narrow but important failure mode in GUI-capable vision-language models: can they correctly bind relational language such as “to the right of Save,” “inside the Layers panel,” or “the third item in the menu” to the intended UI element in a screenshot? Existing agent benchmarks mix grounding with planning, action execution, OCR, and broader task completion, so a wrong click is hard to diagnose. This work turns the problem into a controlled primitive-level grounding test.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to LLM pretraining is limited; this is primarily an evaluation and diagnosis paper for VLMs and computer-use agents. Still, it offers two useful lessons. First, many downstream agent failures may originate from low-level visual localization and spatial binding rather than high-level planning. Second, the benchmark design cleanly separates relation understanding from candidate localization, which is a useful pattern for multimodal capability analysis after pretraining. If your focus is native multimodal pretraining, GUI grounding, or benchmark design, it is worth a quick read. If your focus is text-only pretraining, this is lower priority.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core contribution is GUI-Primitives, a 994-item benchmark organized as 497 contrastive instruction pairs over seven GUI spatial primitives: left/right, above/below, containment, alignment, proximity, list ordinal, and occlusion. In each pair, the screenshot and anchor element stay fixed while the relation expression changes, so the correct target flips between two designated candidates. This minimal-pair construction is the key idea. It suppresses screenshot salience, centrality bias, and fixed-answer shortcuts: a model that always clicks the more salient element can only get one item in the pair correct.

The dataset also includes lexical variation beyond the relation term in 253 of the 497 pairs, changing verbs, head nouns, or anchor quoting, which reduces template memorization. A 196-item subset is validated by five annotators, with Fleiss kappa = 0.94 for well-formedness and kappa = 0.79 for target selection, giving the benchmark a reasonably strong annotation foundation.

Methodologically, the paper goes beyond strict point-in-box accuracy and performs candidate-level analysis. Errors are split into two types: selecting the contrastive wrong candidate versus predicting a point outside both candidate regions. This distinction matters because it changes the diagnosis. A low score does not necessarily mean the model misunderstood the relation word; it may simply have failed to localize either candidate reliably.

The paper also evaluates three training-free interventions: Set-of-Mark prompting, primitive-aware chain-of-thought, and activation steering. SoM explicitly marks the two candidates and therefore acts as an oracle upper bound on candidate discrimination rather than a deployable solution. CoT tests whether explicit reasoning helps. Activation steering tests whether internal representations can be nudged without retraining.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical picture is consistent and fairly stark.

First, absolute performance is poor. Across 19 VLMs, the best model, Claude Opus 4.7, reaches only 31% strict point-in-box accuracy on the human-clean subset; the abstract also states that no model exceeds 32% overall. So even on tightly controlled GUI spatial primitives, current models remain far from human-level grounding.

Second, all tested models fall below the two-candidate reference level of 0.50 on four primitives: containment, occlusion, alignment, and proximity. Candidate-level analysis explains why: the dominant error is not choosing the opposite candidate, but predicting outside both candidate boxes. Depending on the model, off-candidate predictions account for 60% to 92% of errors, and on the real desktop screenshot subset this rises to 96.2%. The main bottleneck therefore looks more like candidate localization failure than relation-word confusion.

Third, the benchmark tracks downstream grounding. For the ten models also evaluated on ScreenSpot-Pro, GUI-Primitives accuracy correlates with downstream grounding accuracy at Spearman rho = +0.74 with p = 0.015. The paper also reports item-level logistic regression over n = 15,810 model-item pairs with pseudo-R^2 = 0.40, which supports the claim that the benchmark is diagnostically meaningful rather than synthetic in a disconnected way.

Fourth, only Set-of-Mark helps substantially. Marking the two candidates improves selection accuracy by 35 to 57 points, raising GPT-5 from 30% to 87% and OS-Atlas from 10% to 52%. Primitive-aware CoT and activation steering do not produce significant gains. This is a useful diagnosis: once the candidate set is made explicit, models can often discriminate between candidates much better than their raw screenshot-grounding scores suggest.

Fifth, shortcut controls behave mostly as expected. Blank canvas, shuffled instructions, and heavy blur reduce performance, indicating that the benchmark is not solved by pure template matching. The blur result is significant but not catastrophic, which suggests some models still rely on coarse visual cues.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this as an evaluation paper. Start with the introduction and the benchmark construction figure to understand why the minimal-pair design matters. Then go directly to the dataset construction section and the candidate-level analysis section. Those two parts contain the paper’s main value: the benchmark is carefully controlled, and the diagnosis is more informative than a single grounding accuracy number.

If time is limited, skim the large model tables and focus on three numbers: the best model is only around 31%, four primitives fall below the 0.50 two-candidate reference, and off-candidate predictions dominate the error profile. Then read the intervention section to see why SoM works while CoT and activation steering do not.

A useful pass takes 20 to 30 minutes. Spend more time only if you work on GUI agents, multimodal pretraining data, or benchmark methodology.

recommendation.zh: GUI agent 评测里少见的 clean 对照集；只看数据构造和错误分解，训练侧暂不必跟进。
recommendation.en: A clean contrastive probe for GUI agents; skim the dataset construction and error breakdown, with no immediate pretraining action.

paper.title: OVIBench: Benchmarking Online Video Question Answering under Interruption
paper.abstract: Recent vision language models (VLMs) have achieved strong progress in video understanding. However, most existing video QA research and benchmarks still follow an offline, single-round paradigm, overlooking realistic interactions where users may interrupt the model during answer generation. To address this gap, we formulate the task of Online Video Question Answering under Interruption and introduce OVIBench, the first standardized benchmark for evaluating VLMs in this setting. OVIBench categori

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的问题不是一般的视频问答，而是“回答进行到一半时，用户插话后模型能否正确改写行为”。传统 VideoQA 默认输入完整视频和问题，一次性输出答案；这里则把交互状态显式纳入任务：模型在看到部分视频、已生成的部分答案、以及中途插入的新指令后，需要先判断打断意图，再决定继续、修正还是终止回答。论文关心的核心不是视觉理解本身，而是在线交互中的状态建模、意图识别和响应切换能力。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身的直接贡献有限，它更接近评测与面向交互场景的后训练数据构造。但它有两个启发点。第一，现有 VLM 在离线 VideoQA 上表现不错，不代表具备在线、可中断、状态依赖的交互能力；这暴露出当前训练分布与真实使用分布之间的缺口。第二，作者用专门构造的 interruption-aware 数据微调后，7B 模型可以超过同系列 72B 基线，说明这类能力目前更受训练信号约束，而不是单纯受参数规模约束。对做多模态预训练的人来说，这提示“交互状态”可能需要更早进入训练目标，而不是只在指令微调阶段补。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上主要有三部分。第一是任务形式化。作者把 Online Video Question Answering under Interruption 定义为一个带中途外部干预的生成任务：在时刻 tq 收到初始问题，模型开始自回归生成；在 ti 时刻收到 interruption，此时上下文包含 V≤ti、Q0、A≤ti 和打断信号 I。模型需要先识别 interruption type，再执行对应策略。作者把打断分成三类：Cancellation、False Trigger、Correction。这个划分不是按表面文本形式，而是按“是否改变语义上下文”和“是否要求改变生成策略”来定义，因此比简单的 stop/continue 标签更贴近交互控制。

第二是 benchmark 构造与离线模拟协议。难点在于“生成过程中被打断”很难大规模、可复现地评测。作者设计了统一时间轴下的离线模拟：先确定问题发起时刻、打断时刻、可见视频片段和部分回答，再让模型在这个冻结状态下继续完成后续响应。这样做牺牲了一部分真实在线系统细节，但换来了批量评测和可重复比较。数据同时提供 open-ended 和 multiple-choice 两种设置：前者更接近真实交互，后者噪声更低，便于稳定比较模型能力。

第三是评测指标与训练集。指标分成 interruption understanding 和 response generation 两大类，不只看最终答对没有，还看是否识别了打断意图、是否满足打断后的新目标、打断前后语言是否连贯、内容是否与视频证据一致。为了验证这不是纯 benchmark 工作，作者还构造了 OVI-Train，多选式 interruption-aware 训练集，并对 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 做定向微调。这里的设计选择很务实：先用结构化多选任务把“识别打断类型—选择响应策略”这条链条训稳，而不是直接依赖开放生成去学复杂行为。
summary.experiments:
实验结论比较清楚。主流 MLLM 在标准离线 VideoQA 上可以表现良好，但在 OVI 设定下明显掉队，尤其在 Correction 这类需要推翻或修正已有回答的场景中最弱。这说明模型不是单纯缺视频理解，而是缺“在生成轨迹中更新意图并重写策略”的能力。

论文最有信息量的结果来自定向微调：基于 OVI-Train 训练后的 7B 模型，相比 Qwen2.5-VL-7B，在 multiple-choice accuracy 上提升 16.88%，在 interruption-type accuracy 上提升 13.94%，并且超过同系列 72B 模型。这个结果很说明问题：更大的模型如果没有见过对应训练信号，未必能自然学会中途纠偏和控制；而合适的数据与任务分解可以显著补足这类能力。

从实验结构看，作者还比较了 open-ended 与 multiple-choice 两种评测形式。前者更贴近真实使用，但评测噪声更大；后者更适合做模型间稳定比较和训练闭环验证。若把这篇工作当成能力诊断工具，多选设置的价值其实更高，因为它更容易把“视觉理解错误”和“打断处理错误”拆开看。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看任务定义图和 interruption taxonomy，理解作者到底把什么算作“打断”，以及为什么要区分 Cancellation、False Trigger、Correction。然后看离线模拟协议，这部分决定了 benchmark 是否可复现，也决定了它与真实在线系统之间的差距。接着看指标设计，重点看作者如何把 intent recognition、post-interruption fulfillment、fluency、evidence consistency 拆开。最后看 OVI-Train 微调结果，尤其是 7B 超过 72B 的那组表，这是整篇最有启发的一点。

预计阅读时间 20 到 30 分钟。若只关心是否值得纳入研究视野，看 introduction、benchmark construction、main results 三部分即可。若想判断它能否迁移到更一般的多轮多模态 agent 训练，再细看数据构造细节和错误案例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a capability that standard VideoQA largely ignores: how a video-language model should react when the user interrupts it mid-generation. Instead of a one-shot mapping from full video and question to final answer, the model now sees a partial video stream, a partially generated answer, and a new interruption signal. It must infer the interruption intent and switch behavior accordingly—continue, revise, or stop. The central issue is therefore state-aware interaction modeling, not just video understanding.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense; it is primarily an evaluation and training-data construction effort for interruption-aware multimodal interaction. Still, it matters for foundation-model research in two ways. First, it shows that strong offline VideoQA performance does not imply competence in online, interruptible interaction. That gap reflects a mismatch between current training distributions and real deployment conditions. Second, the fine-tuned 7B model surpassing a 72B model from the same family suggests that this capability is currently bottlenecked more by training signal than by scale alone. For pretraining researchers, that is a useful reminder that interaction state may need to enter the learning objective earlier, rather than being deferred entirely to instruction tuning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has three main components. First, it formalizes Online Video Question Answering under Interruption. A user asks an initial question at time tq, the model starts autoregressive generation, and an interruption arrives at time ti. The observable context is the partial video V≤ti, the original question Q0, the partial answer A≤ti, and the interruption signal I. The model must jointly perform interruption-type recognition and response generation. The interruption taxonomy has three classes—Cancellation, False Trigger, and Correction—defined by whether the interruption changes the semantic context and whether it requires a change in generation strategy. That is a more meaningful decomposition than a simple stop/continue label.

Second, the paper builds OVIBench and an offline simulation protocol. The key practical challenge is reproducibility: true online interruption during generation is hard to benchmark at scale. The proposed protocol freezes a unified temporal state—what video has been seen, what has been generated, and when the interruption occurs—so models can be evaluated in a controlled and repeatable way. The benchmark supports both open-ended and multiple-choice settings. Open-ended evaluation is closer to real interaction, while multiple-choice reduces evaluation noise and makes model comparison more stable.

Third, the paper introduces a metric suite and a training set. Metrics cover interruption understanding and response generation, including interruption-intent recognition, post-interruption intent fulfillment, fluency and consistency before and after interruption, and alignment with video evidence. To test whether the benchmark can support improvement rather than only diagnosis, the authors construct OVI-Train, a multiple-choice training set for interruption-aware fine-tuning. The design choice is pragmatic: use a structured format to teach the model the chain from interruption recognition to response strategy, instead of relying only on unconstrained generation to absorb this behavior.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical result is straightforward: mainstream MLLMs that perform well on standard offline VideoQA degrade substantially under interruption. The weakest case is Correction, where the model must revise or override an ongoing answer rather than simply continue or stop. That pattern suggests the failure is not only in visual grounding, but in updating intent and rewriting generation policy mid-trajectory.

The most informative quantitative result comes from targeted fine-tuning. Starting from Qwen2.5-VL-7B, the interruption-aware fine-tuned 7B model improves multiple-choice accuracy by 16.88% and interruption-type accuracy by 13.94%, and even surpasses the 72B model in the same series. That is a strong indication that interruption handling is highly data- and objective-sensitive. Larger scale alone does not reliably induce the behavior if the model never sees the right supervision.

The paper also contrasts open-ended and multiple-choice evaluation. Open-ended testing is more realistic but noisier; multiple-choice is cleaner for controlled comparison and for closing the train-eval loop. If the benchmark is used as a diagnostic tool, the multiple-choice setting is especially useful because it helps separate failures in video understanding from failures in interruption handling.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the task definition and interruption taxonomy. That clarifies what the authors count as an interruption and why the three-way split matters. Then read the offline simulation protocol, since that is the core design choice enabling reproducible evaluation. After that, inspect the metric design to see how the paper separates intent recognition, post-interruption fulfillment, fluency, and evidence consistency. Finally, look at the OVI-Train fine-tuning results, especially the table where the tuned 7B model beats the 72B baseline; that is the most consequential result in the paper.

Estimated reading time is 20–30 minutes. If the goal is only to decide relevance, the introduction, benchmark construction, and main result tables are enough. If the goal is to adapt the setup to broader multimodal agent training, spend more time on data construction details and failure cases.

recommendation.zh: 关注 VLM 在流式交互中的'被打断'能力，评测 setup 比较新颖，对做实时多模态交互（类似 GPT-4o 语音模式）的团队有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Focuses on VLMs' ability to handle 'interruptions' in streaming interactions; the novel evaluation setup is valuable for teams working on real-time multimodal interactions (like GPT-4o's voice mode).

paper.title: A VLM Answer Is Not an Anomaly Score: Rank Compression in Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection
paper.abstract: Vision-language models enable training-free video anomaly detection by answering questions about video segments. VAD benchmarks, however, require a scalar anomaly score for each segment and evaluate the resulting ranking using the AUROC or AP. A VLM-based detector should therefore define an answer interface: the answer scale specifies the admissible answers, and the readout rule maps the model's output distribution to a score.
