summary.experiments: 测试了6个前沿闭源和开源VLM，覆盖稠密和MoE架构、三个数量级的激活参数量：体积重排规划准确率达53%-97%，碰撞约束错误率低于7%；遮挡推理准确率暴跌到6%-45%；反射的光学几何推理准确率低于7%，三类任务间存在超过50个百分点的能力断层。三种独立的遮挡推理测试结果在5个模型上的偏差不超过12个百分点，排除了任务特定表面特征的影响。面向具身推理的Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6在200样本的失败案子集上也表现出相同的能力剖面，说明当前的具身推理后训练也无法修复这一缺陷。白盒分析显示，推理失败时Qwen3-VL对几何正确区域的视觉注意力分散，与均匀随机水平相当；激活补丁定位缺陷发生在视觉令牌融合层：ViT内部可恢复的空间信息在压缩后无法被下游计算访问，恢复融合后第一层语言模型的激活即可修复性能。
summary.reading_guide: 精读核心假设提出、基准设计逻辑、能力分层实验结果、白盒机制分析部分，重点关注能力断层数据和激活补丁结果；可跳过具体的标注流程细节。值得深挖的点包括：3D空间预训练信号的设计、视觉令牌融合层的架构优化、不需要显式3D标注的空间结构诱导训练方法。

summary_en.core_problem: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) perform well on static object recognition, but it is unclear whether they have genuine 3D scene structure representation capabilities, or only perform flat catalog-style enumeration of visible objects. This capability is the core foundation for VLMs to act as the perception layer of embodied systems.
summary_en.importance: Systematically quantifies the capability boundary of current VLMs in 3D spatial geometric reasoning, locates the core bottleneck of existing ViT+LM spliced VLM architectures, and provides clear optimization directions for architecture design, evaluation system, and pretraining signal design of multimodal foundation pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds a 3,034-sample human-curated evaluation benchmark covering three types of 3D spatial understanding capabilities: depth-ordered occlusion reasoning (validated via three independent counterfactual operationalizations), optical-geometry inference over visible reflections, and volumetric rearrangement planning. All evaluation results are scored by trained annotators, no LLM-as-judge is used to avoid evaluation bias. White-box analysis is conducted on the open-source Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking, with a Depth-Guided Attention Relevance (DGAR) metric designed, and activation patching used to locate the architectural site of the capability deficit.
summary_en.experiments: Six cutting-edge closed-source and open-source VLMs are tested, covering dense and MoE architectures, and three orders of magnitude of active parameters: volumetric rearrangement planning accuracy reaches 53%-97%, with collision constraint error rate lower than 7%; occlusion reasoning accuracy drops sharply to 6%-45%; optical-geometry inference over reflections has accuracy lower than 7%, with a capability gap of over 50 percentage points between the three types of tasks. The results of three independent occlusion reasoning tests deviate by no more than 12 percentage points across five models, ruling out the influence of task-specific surface features. Embodied reasoning model Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6 reproduces the same capability profile on a 200-sample subset of failure cases, indicating that current embodied reasoning post-training cannot fix this deficit. White-box analysis shows that during reasoning failures, the visual attention of Qwen3-VL to geometrically correct regions is dispersed, equivalent to uniform random level. Activation patching locates the defect at the visual token merger layer: spatial information recoverable inside the ViT becomes inaccessible to downstream computation after compression, and restoring activations of the first language model layer after the merger can recover performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Intensively read the core hypothesis proposal in Section 1, benchmark design logic in Section 3, capability stratification experimental results in Section 4, and white-box mechanism analysis in Section 5. Focus on the capability gap data in Figure 2 and activation patching results in Figure 4; specific annotation process details can be skipped. Points worth further exploration include: design of 3D spatial pretraining signals, architecture optimization of the visual token merger layer, and spatial structure induction training methods that do not require explicit 3D annotations.

recommendation.zh: 把“VLM 不懂 3D”从泛泛结论变成可定位的工程问题：重点看白盒定位 merger/压缩那段，直接指导视觉 token 数与融合策略的 ablation。
recommendation.en: Turns “VLMs lack 3D understanding” into an actionable diagnosis: focus on the white-box evidence around merger/compression—worth immediate ablations on visual token count and fusion design.

paper.title: CaMo: Camera Motion Grounded Evaluation and Training for Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) achieve strong performance on spatial question answering benchmarks, yet it remains unclear whether such gains reflect genuine spatial intelligence. We show that existing spatial VLMs lack basic camera motion understanding, a key component of spatial cognition. We propose the Spatial Narrative Score (SNS), an evaluation framework that requires VLMs to generate explicit spatial narratives capturing both scene semantics and camera motion, followed by reasoning with a

summary.core_problem: 现有空间问答VLM的高分可能是“题型拟合”，并不代表理解相机运动与可迁移的3D空间认知。
summary.importance: 属于VLM评测与训练信号设计：用“显式叙事外化+冻结LLM代理推理”来测相机运动理解，能作为多模态预训练/对齐时的诊断工具，但不是预训练范式创新。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Spatial Narrative Score (SNS)：要求VLM生成包含场景语义与相机运动的显式空间叙事，再交给冻结的proxy LLM做推理评分；并提出CaMo，通过相机运动grounding的训练让模型在SNS与直接QA上更一致。
summary.experiments: 摘要结论：SOTA空间VLM在SNS下显著掉分但直接QA仍高；CaMo在SNS与QA上更稳定。摘要未给出具体模型、数据规模与提升数值。

summary_en.core_problem: High scores on spatial QA benchmarks may not reflect genuine camera-motion understanding or transferable 3D spatial cognition in VLMs.
summary_en.importance: An evaluation/training-signal design for VLMs: explicit narrative externalization plus a frozen LLM judge can serve as a diagnostic for multimodal pretraining/alignment, though it’s not a new pretraining paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Spatial Narrative Score (SNS): VLM must generate explicit spatial narratives capturing semantics and camera motion, then a frozen proxy LLM performs reasoning/scoring; proposes CaMo, a camera-motion-grounded VLM trained to be consistent on SNS and direct QA.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract reports strong degradation of SOTA spatial VLMs under SNS despite high direct QA accuracy; CaMo improves consistency across both. No model/data scale or numeric deltas in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 把SNS当“空间能力的反作弊评测”：只看SNS协议和失败案例就够了；训练部分更像针对性补课，不必深读。
recommendation.en: Use SNS as an anti-cheating diagnostic for spatial capability—skim the protocol and failure cases; the training recipe feels like targeted patching rather than a general pretraining insight.

paper.title: Physics-R1: An Audited Olympiad Corpus and Recipe for Visual Physics Reasoning
paper.abstract: We audit the multimodal-physics evaluation pipeline end-to-end and document three undetected construction practices that distort how the field measures vision-language reasoning: train-eval contamination, translation drift, and MCQ saturation. (1) Public training pools (UGPhysics-Train, SciInstruct, MMK12) pass single-stage 5-gram-Jaccard audits with zero hits across all six public physics evals; a three-stage audit (Jaccard -> mxbai-embed-large cosine -> Haiku-4.5 LLM-judge) surfaces 134 near-d

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是多模态物理推理评测的可信度问题：公开训练池与评测集之间存在常规 n-gram 去重发现不了的近重复和改写污染；翻译版本会改变题目信息；选择题格式在前沿模型上接近饱和，掩盖开放式物理推理差异。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练研究的价值在数据审计与评测构造，而不在 Physics-R1 模型本身。论文给出一个比较完整的物理-VL数据闭环：先审计污染，再构造开放式、原语言、novel-source 的 held-out benchmark，最后用 RL recipe 验证数据可训练但不是靠记忆提升。这个思路适合迁移到数学、代码、科学推理等高污染领域。它也提醒多模态推理数据不能只做 within-pool dedup；embedding 近邻和 LLM judge 的组合能发现 n-gram 方法漏掉的 paraphrase leakage。
summary.technical_approach: 技术方案分四部分。第一，提出三阶段审计流程：5-gram Jaccard 先做高精度文本重合筛查；mxbai-embed-large cosine 再找语义近邻；Haiku-4.5 LLM judge 最后把候选区分为 close duplicate 和 same-topic neighbor，降低 embedding 检索带来的误报。第二，构建 PhysCorp-A 和 PhysR1Corp，将污染审计直接放进训练语料构建流程。第三，构建 PhysOlym-A，强调开放式答案、原始语言 gold、native difficulty calibration，并披露 Sonnet-as-judge 的 unjudgeable rate。第四，给出 Physics-R1 训练 recipe：从 Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking cold-start，采用 GSPO+DAPO，并推荐 binary correctness reward。作者认为二值正确性信号比单位、守恒、格式等 dense proxy 更稳，因为 group-normalized advantage 下它方差更合适，也更不容易被模型优化奖励漏洞。
summary.experiments: 审计结果是论文最有信息量的部分。常规 5-gram Jaccard 在 UGPhysics-Train、SciInstruct、MMK12 对六个公开 physics eval 的检查中全部报告 0 hit；加入 embedding 后，仅 SciInstruct 就出现 4,846 个 paraphrase-class candidate，其中 PhysReason-full 2,687 个、PhysUniBench-en 1,027 个；Haiku-4.5 进一步判定其中 134 个为 close duplicates。UGPhysics-Train 有 9 个候选，MMK12 有 66 个候选。在 PhysCorp-pre-audit 的 1,679 条研究者采样中，仅 Stage-1 对六个公开 eval 就发现 345 条泄漏，占 20.5%，主要集中在 PhysUniBench-en 和 MMMU-Pro Physics。翻译漂移实验中，Sonnet 4.5 在 59 个爱沙尼亚语/英语配对奥赛题上，原始爱沙尼亚语 strict accuracy 为 30.5%，英语翻译版为 13.6%；sign test p=0.011，McNemar p=0.021，bootstrap 95% CI 为 +5.1 到 +28.9 pp。格式实验中，同一 Sonnet 4.5 权重在 PhyX 四选一题上得 79.7%，在 OlympiadBench-Physics 上 liberal score 为 50.4%，在作者构造的 held-out audited eval 上 liberal score 为 33.4%。Physics-R1 在 audited held-out eval 上超过 8B base，但仍落后闭源前沿模型；3 seed sweep 中，PUB-OE、OlymBench-Phys、PhysOlym-A 的标准差不超过 3.3 pp，PhysReason 为 6.4 pp，seed-42 是离群点。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 35–45 分钟。优先读 Section 3 的数据审计和语料构建，特别是三阶段 audit 的阈值、误报处理和 close duplicate 定义；再看 Section 5.1 的翻译漂移与格式饱和实验，这部分直接影响 benchmark 可信度；最后读 Section 4 的 RL recipe，重点看为什么选择 binary correctness reward，而不是 dense physics-native reward。表格上重点看 Table 2 的公开训练池污染审计、Table 4 的 PhysCorp-pre-audit 泄漏率、Table 3 的 Physics-R1 训练结果和 seed sensitivity。若时间有限，可以跳过模型训练细节，把它当作数据可训练性的 sanity check。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper audits the measurement pipeline for multimodal physics reasoning. It identifies three concrete sources of distortion: paraphrase-level train-eval contamination missed by n-gram deduplication, information loss introduced by translated problem statements, and multiple-choice saturation that hides differences in open-ended reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly about data governance and benchmark construction, not about a new pretraining method. Its relevance to foundation-model research is that it gives a practical recipe for building scientific-reasoning data: audit public pools against evaluation sets, preserve original-language gold when possible, and evaluate on open-ended novel-source problems. The same pattern is applicable to math, code, and other domains where public data reuse makes contamination hard to detect. It also shows why within-pool deduplication is insufficient; semantic retrieval plus a precision-oriented judge can expose leakage that n-gram overlap misses.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work has four components. First, it proposes a three-stage audit: 5-gram Jaccard for exact or near-exact overlap, mxbai-embed-large cosine search for semantic neighbors, and a Haiku-4.5 judge to classify candidates into close duplicates or same-topic neighbors. Second, it builds audited training artifacts, including PhysCorp-A and PhysR1Corp, with the audit embedded into corpus construction rather than applied after the fact. Third, it releases PhysOlym-A, an open-ended held-out olympiad benchmark with original-language calibration, an English/Estonian bilingual subset, and a disclosed Sonnet-as-judge unjudgeable rate. Fourth, it provides Physics-R1 as a trainability check: the model is cold-started from Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking and trained with a GSPO+DAPO recipe. The preferred reward is binary correctness, chosen over dense physics-specific proxies because it is less exposed to reward hacking through units, conservation checks, or formatting cues and is easier to port across harnesses.
summary_en.experiments: The audit results are the strongest part. A conventional 5-gram Jaccard audit reports zero hits for UGPhysics-Train, SciInstruct, and MMK12 against six public physics evaluations. After embedding retrieval, SciInstruct alone yields 4,846 paraphrase-class candidates, dominated by PhysReason-full with 2,687 and PhysUniBench-en with 1,027. The LLM-judge stage labels 134 of these SciInstruct candidates as close duplicates. UGPhysics-Train yields 9 candidates and MMK12 yields 66. On a 1,679-record sample from PhysCorp-pre-audit, Stage-1 alone finds 345 leaks against the six public evaluations, or 20.5%, concentrated in PhysUniBench-en and MMMU-Pro Physics. The translation study uses 59 paired Estonian/English olympiad problems: Sonnet 4.5 scores 30.5% strict accuracy on the Estonian originals and 13.6% on the English translations, with sign-test p=0.011, McNemar p=0.021, and a bootstrap 95% confidence interval of +5.1 to +28.9 percentage points. The format study shows the same Sonnet 4.5 weights scoring 79.7% on the four-way MCQ PhyX benchmark, 50.4% liberal on OlympiadBench-Physics, and 33.4% liberal on the new held-out audited evaluation. Physics-R1 improves over the 8B base on the audited held-out set but remains behind closed frontier models. The three-seed sweep reports standard deviation no larger than 3.3 points on PUB-OE, OlymBench-Phys, and PhysOlym-A, with 6.4 points on PhysReason due to a seed-42 outlier.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 35–45 minutes. Read the data-audit and corpus-construction section first, especially the thresholds, candidate labeling rules, and definition of close duplicate. Then read the translation-drift and format-saturation experiments, because these directly affect benchmark interpretation. The RL section is useful but secondary; focus on the argument for binary correctness reward versus dense physics-native reward. The most useful tables are the public-pool contamination audit, the PhysCorp-pre-audit leakage analysis, and the Physics-R1 seed-sensitivity table. If time is limited, treat the model-training result as a sanity check that the audited corpus is trainable, not as the central claim.

recommendation.zh: 读审计流程和三个数字即可；若结果复现，很多 VLM 物理榜单只能当弱证据。
recommendation.en: Read the audit pipeline and the three gaps; if replicated, many VLM physics leaderboards become weak evidence.

paper.title: A Multimodal Dataset for Visually Grounded Ambiguity in Machine Translation
paper.abstract: Ambiguity resolution is a key challenge in multimodal machine translation (MMT), where models must genuinely leverage visual input to map an ambiguous expression to its intended meaning. Although prior work has proposed disambiguation-oriented benchmarks that provide supportive evidence for the role of vision, we observe substantial issues in data quality and a mismatch with translation scenarios. Moreover, existing ambiguity-oriented evaluations are not well suited to broader ambiguity types in

summary.core_problem: 多模态机器翻译中，模型是否真正利用图像来消解源语言歧义，现有数据集质量和任务匹配度不足。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态理解评测数据集。它聚焦视觉依赖的歧义消解，比一般图文翻译指标更能检查视觉信息是否参与了语言选择。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VIDA，包含2500个精心标注样例，每个样例标出需要视觉证据才能消解的源语言歧义片段；同时提出 Disambiguation-Centric Metrics，用 LLM-as-a-judge 分类器在span级检查歧义表达是否被正确翻译。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到用两个强LVLM在vanilla inference设置下实验，但未给出模型名称、语言方向、分数或提升幅度。核心评测应关注歧义span解析准确率，而非只看整体翻译质量。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Universität Hamburg Department of Informatics；Longyue Wang、Liang Ding 等作者有机器翻译和多模态NLP相关工作背景。

summary_en.core_problem: In multimodal machine translation, existing datasets do not reliably test whether models actually use visual evidence to resolve source-language ambiguity.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal evaluation dataset contribution. It focuses on visually dependent ambiguity resolution, which is more diagnostic than generic image-conditioned translation scores.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces VIDA, a 2,500-instance curated dataset with annotated ambiguous source spans that require visual evidence, and Disambiguation-Centric Metrics that use an LLM-as-a-judge classifier to evaluate span-level ambiguity resolution.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions experiments with two strong large vision-language models under vanilla inference, but does not provide model names, language directions, scores, or improvements. The key evaluation is expected to be span-level disambiguation accuracy rather than overall translation quality.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the Department of Informatics at Universität Hamburg; Longyue Wang and Liang Ding have prior work in machine translation and multimodal NLP.

recommendation.zh: 知道有这个数据集即可；它对VLM grounding eval有用，但翻译场景太窄，不值得预训练侧细读。
recommendation.en: Useful to know as a grounding eval dataset, but the MT setting is narrow enough that pretraining researchers can skip the full paper.

paper.title: Beyond Screenshots: Evaluating VLMs' Understanding of UI Animations
paper.abstract: AI agents operating on user interfaces must understand how interfaces communicate state and feedback to act reliably. As a core communicative modality, animations are increasingly used in modern interfaces, serving critical functional purposes beyond mere aesthetics. Thus, understanding UI animation is essential for comprehensive interface interpretation. However, recent studies of Vision Language Models (VLMs) for UI understanding have focused primarily on static screenshots, leaving it unclear

summary.core_problem: 现有 UI 理解评测多依赖静态截图，无法回答 VLM 是否理解界面动画所表达的状态变化、反馈和交互含义。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个面向 UI 动画理解的小规模密集标注 benchmark。它补上了 GUI/VLM 评测中的动态界面维度，对多模态 Agent 的感知评测有价值，但离基座预训练方法较远。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 AniMINT，包含 300 个密集标注的 UI animation videos；评测 VLM 对动画效果感知、动画目的识别、动画含义解释等层级能力，区分低层运动检测和高层语义解释。
summary.experiments: 系统评测若干当前 VLM。摘要结论是模型能较可靠地检测 primitive motion，但高层动画解释不稳定；具体模型列表、评分协议和数值需要看正文。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing UI-understanding evaluations focus on static screenshots, leaving unclear whether VLMs understand state changes, feedback, and interaction meaning conveyed through UI animations.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a small but densely annotated benchmark for UI animation understanding. It is useful for evaluating GUI-oriented multimodal agents, though it is not directly about base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce AniMINT, a dataset of 300 densely annotated UI animation videos. They evaluate VLMs on multiple levels: perceiving animation effects, identifying animation purposes, and interpreting animation meaning.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates current VLMs. The abstract reports that models can reliably detect primitive motion but remain inconsistent on high-level animation interpretation; exact model lists and scores require the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务定义和错误类型即可；它提醒 native multimodal 训练别只吃截图，但 300 条数据不足以支撑强结论。
recommendation.en: Read the task definition and error taxonomy only; it reminds native multimodal training not to overfit screenshots, but 300 videos cannot support strong claims.

paper.title: Assessing Y-Axis Influence: Bias in Multimodal Language Models on Chart-to-Table Translation
paper.abstract: Chart-to-table translation converts chart images into structured tabular data. Accurate translation is crucial for Multimodal Language Model (MLM) to answer complex queries. We observe imbalances in the number of images across different aspects of the y-axis information in public chart datasets. Such imbalances can introduce unintended biases, causing uneven MLM performance. Previous works have not systematically examined these biases. To address this gap, we propose a new framework, FairChart2T

summary.core_problem: 现有公开图表数据集的Y轴信息分布不平衡，导致多模态大模型在图表转表格任务上存在未被系统研究的Y轴相关偏见
summary.importance: 首次系统分析VLM在图表转表格任务的Y轴偏见，提出FairChart2Table分析框架
summary.technical_approach: 在5个SOTA多模态模型上测试Y轴刻度属性、图例数量对性能的影响，验证添加Y轴信息提示的优化效果
summary.experiments: 发现Y轴刻度位数、数量、范围、格式均存在显著偏见，图例数量影响性能，添加Y轴信息提示可提升部分模型表现

summary_en.core_problem: Public chart datasets have imbalanced Y-axis information distribution, leading to unstudied Y-axis related biases of multimodal large models in chart-to-table translation tasks
summary_en.importance: First systematic analysis of VLM Y-axis bias in chart-to-table tasks, proposes FairChart2Table analysis framework
summary_en.technical_approach: Test impact of Y-axis tick attributes and legend count on performance across 5 SOTA multimodal models, verify optimization effect of adding Y-axis information in prompts
summary_en.experiments: Find significant biases related to Y-axis tick digit length, count, range, format, legend count impacts performance, adding Y-axis prompt information improves performance of some models

recommendation.zh: 多模态图表理解的细分场景偏见分析，仅作为文献备查，无需读正文
recommendation.en: Bias analysis for VLM in chart-to-table task, only for literature reference, no need to read full text

paper.title: ReVSI: Rebuilding Visual Spatial Intelligence Evaluation for Accurate Assessment of VLM 3D Reasoning
paper.abstract: Current evaluations of spatial intelligence can be systematically invalid under modern vision-language model (VLM) settings. First, many benchmarks derive question-answer (QA) pairs from point-cloud-based 3D annotations originally curated for traditional 3D perception. When such annotations are treated as ground truth for video-based evaluation, reconstruction and annotation artifacts can miss objects that are clearly visible in the video, mislabel object identities, or corrupt geometry-dependen

summary.core_problem: 现有 VLM 3D 空间推理评测常把点云或 mesh 上的 3D 标注直接转成视频 QA，但这些标注和模型实际看到的视频帧不一致，导致问题、答案和视觉证据之间出现系统性错配。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练方法本身没有提出新目标或新架构，但对多模态基座模型评测很有参考价值。它指出一个容易被忽略的问题：空间推理 benchmark 的错误不只是噪声，而可能系统性改变模型排序。对于做 VLM 预训练或空间能力 post-training 的研究者，关键启发是评测数据必须和输入预算绑定。否则模型失败可能来自看不到关键物体，而不是缺少空间推理能力；模型成功也可能来自数据先验，而不是视觉 grounding。
summary.technical_approach: ReVSI 重建了 VSI-Bench 的评测流程。核心原则是让模型看到的内容和 benchmark 询问的内容严格一致。做法包括三部分。第一，重新标注物体类别和场景几何，使用专业 3D 标注工具修正原始重建中的漏标、错标和几何误差。第二，重新生成 QA，增加模板多样性，并控制答案分布，减少通过语言或统计偏置猜答案的空间。所有问题经过人工检查，确保在视频证据下可回答。第三，重新定义 frame-budgeted evaluation，为不同帧预算构造对应版本，并记录细粒度物体可见性。这个设计和传统全场景标注评测不同，它不默认模型能看到完整场景，而是把可观测性纳入 ground truth。
summary.experiments: 实验主要比较 ReVSI 和原 VSI-Bench 下的模型行为。零样本设置中，闭源模型在更高质量标注下表现较稳定，部分结果还更高；开源模型则出现明显下降，最高下降约 40%，主要集中在物体计数、相对距离、相对方向等任务。针对 3D 空间推理数据微调过的模型，在 ReVSI 上的增益明显小于在 VSI-Bench 上的增益；扩大 post-training 数据也没有稳定带来提升，部分任务甚至低于基座模型。论文还利用可见性标注做 stress test，例如在物体计数中移除所有包含目标物体的帧，或在尺寸估计中用黑图替换输入。合理的视觉 grounded 模型应当在这些设置下失败，但若干模型仍取得较高分数，包括文中提到的 InternVL3.5，说明它们在部分问题上依赖非视觉先验。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中两个失效模式：annotation-to-video ground-truth drift 和 scene-observability mismatch。再看数据重标注、QA 生成、frame-budget 版本构造的部分，重点理解它如何把输入帧和问题可回答性绑定。实验部分建议看 Table 3、Table 4、Table 5、Table 6，以及 Figure 1 和 Figure 8 的错误案例。若正在做 VLM 空间能力评测或空间推理数据合成，可重点读可见性标注和 evidence-absent controls，这部分对设计反偏置评测更有用。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 Simon Fraser University、Hong Kong University of Science and Technology、University of Waterloo、Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute。通信作者为 Yiming Zhang；论文标注有共同一作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a validity problem in VLM spatial-reasoning evaluation: QA pairs derived from point-cloud or mesh annotations often do not match the actual video frames consumed by modern VLMs.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly about evaluation quality rather than pretraining methodology. Its value for multimodal foundation-model research is clear: spatial-reasoning scores can be distorted when ground truth is tied to imperfect 3D reconstructions instead of the visible input. This matters when using such benchmarks to choose pretraining data, compare visual encoders, or evaluate spatial post-training. A model may fail because the evidence is absent, not because it lacks spatial reasoning; it may also succeed by exploiting priors rather than visual grounding.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReVSI rebuilds the VSI-Bench pipeline around input-consistent evaluation. It re-annotates object labels and scene geometry with professional 3D annotation tools, correcting missing objects, wrong identities, and geometry errors from imperfect reconstructions. It then regenerates QA pairs with more diverse templates and controlled answer distributions, followed by human verification to ensure that each question is well-defined under the video evidence. A key design choice is frame-budgeted evaluation: different frame budgets receive corresponding valid QA sets, and fine-grained object visibility is recorded. This differs from full-scene annotation reuse, where the benchmark implicitly assumes that the model has access to evidence that may never appear in its sampled frames.
summary_en.experiments: The reported results show that ReVSI changes the interpretation of model capability. In zero-shot evaluation, proprietary models are relatively stable and sometimes improve under the cleaned benchmark, while open-source models can drop by up to 40%, especially on object counting, relative distance, and relative direction. Models fine-tuned on 3D spatial-reasoning data obtain smaller gains on ReVSI than on VSI-Bench, and scaling post-training data does not consistently help; some fine-tuned models underperform their base models on specific tasks. Visibility-based stress tests are particularly diagnostic: removing all frames containing a queried object for counting, or replacing frames with black images for size estimation, should break grounded models. Several models still score surprisingly high, including InternVL3.5 in the examples, indicating reliance on non-visual priors.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most pretraining researchers. Focus first on the two failure modes in the introduction: annotation-to-video ground-truth drift and scene-observability mismatch. Then read the dataset reconstruction pipeline, especially QA regeneration, answer-distribution control, human verification, and frame-budgeted variants. The most useful experimental parts are Tables 3–6 and the qualitative examples in Figures 1 and 8. For researchers building VLM evaluations or spatial post-training data, the visibility annotations and evidence-absent controls are the main pieces to study.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed affiliations include Simon Fraser University, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, University of Waterloo, and the Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute. Yiming Zhang is listed as the corresponding author; the paper marks equal contribution.

recommendation.zh: 读数据审计和模型排序变化；它不是训练方法，但会影响你信不信 3D VLM benchmark 的结论。
recommendation.en: Read the data audit and ranking-shift results; it is not a training paper, but it changes how much to trust 3D VLM benchmarks.

paper.title: Don't Pause! Every prediction matters in a streaming video
paper.abstract: Streaming video models should respond the moment an event unfolds, not after the moment has passed. Yet existing online VideoQA benchmarks remain largely retrospective. They pause the video at fixed timestamps, pose questions about current or past events, and score models only at those moments. This protocol leaves streaming predictions untested. To close this gap, we introduce SPOT-Bench, featuring multi-turn proactive queries that evaluate general streaming perception and assistive capabilitie

summary.core_problem: 现有在线 VideoQA benchmark 多采用“暂停视频、提问、回答”的评测协议，无法衡量模型在连续视频流中是否能及时、克制、主动地响应事件。
summary.importance: 这篇工作和 LLM 预训练的直接关系不强，但对流式多模态模型的评测、post-training 目标设计和推理时记忆管理有参考意义。它把问题从“模型是否知道视频里发生了什么”推进到“模型是否在正确时间说正确的话，并且在不该说时保持沉默”。这个区分很重要。实验显示，很多离线 MLLM 的事件感知能力并不是主要瓶颈，真正的问题是流式部署时重复输出和误触发。对训练研究的启发是，流式助手需要显式建模 silence、turn state 和时间窗口，而不是只扩大视频指令数据。
summary.technical_approach: SPOT-Bench 包含 940 个视频、约 68 小时，覆盖第一视角和第三视角场景。任务从传统检测扩展到 interaction 和 intervention，例如在做饭或辅助视觉障碍用户时，在合适时刻给出提醒。评测不再只在固定时间点打分，而是要求模型完整流式处理视频，并在整个时间轴上接受评估。核心指标 Timeliness-F1 同时衡量三件事：响应是否及时，多轮指令是否保持一致，输出频率是否合理。论文还提出 AsynKV 作为训练-free 适配方法。它显式追踪 query-response 状态，在连续帧之间抑制重复响应；同时利用没有活跃查询的 dead-time 异步做摘要和记忆管理，从而扩展时间上下文而不增加响应延迟。它和 silence objective post-training 的区别是尽量保留离线模型已有的事件感知能力，而不是通过训练让模型更少说话。
summary.experiments: SPOT-Bench 上闭源模型明显领先。开源离线 MLLM 在基础事件检测上并非完全失效，但在 interaction 和 intervention 任务上表现差距很大；开源流式 VideoLLM，即按因果方式增量处理帧的模型，结果更差。一个关键诊断是过度响应：离线 MLLM 在流式推理时会向预测流中灌入重复或无提示响应。使用带 silence 目标的流式数据 post-training 可以降低 false positive，但同时提高 false negative，使模型变得不够响应。Timeliness-F1 能把这类 trade-off 暴露出来，而传统暂停式评测通常看不到。AsynKV 在不训练模型的情况下抑制重复输出，并利用空闲计算做记忆更新，作为 proactive VideoQA 的强基线。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。先看 benchmark 设计，理解 detection、interaction、intervention 三类任务的差异。再看 Timeliness-F1 的定义，因为它是这篇工作的核心：它如何同时惩罚延迟、遗漏和刷屏式输出。实验部分重点看模型行为分析，尤其是离线 MLLM 的 over-response、silence objective 带来的 false-positive 和 false-negative 取舍。若关注推理系统或长视频记忆，可再读 AsynKV 的算法部分；应用场景描述可以快速略过。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a gap in online VideoQA evaluation: pause-and-answer protocols do not measure whether a model can respond continuously, proactively, and at the right time during a live video stream.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to streaming multimodal foundation models, post-training objectives, and inference-time memory design. Its main lesson is that event recognition and response policy are different capabilities. Many offline MLLMs can recognize events, yet fail as streaming assistants because they repeat themselves, respond too early or too late, or speak when no response is needed. This suggests that streaming training should explicitly model silence, turn state, temporal windows, and response suppression, rather than treating the problem as ordinary video instruction tuning.
summary_en.technical_approach: SPOT-Bench contains 940 videos and about 68 hours of egocentric and exocentric footage. It uses multi-turn proactive queries and covers detection, interaction, and intervention tasks. Instead of asking questions only at fixed pause points, the benchmark evaluates model outputs continuously across the video timeline. The proposed Timeliness-F1 metric combines temporal precision, multi-turn instruction following, and response frequency, so both missed responses and excessive responses are penalized. The paper also introduces AsynKV, a training-free adaptation method for offline MLLMs. It explicitly tracks query-response state across frames to suppress repetitive outputs, and uses dead-time between active query windows to run summarization and memory management asynchronously. This keeps the offline model’s perception ability while improving streaming behavior without retraining.
summary_en.experiments: Closed-source models lead the benchmark by a clear margin. Open-source offline MLLMs can often perceive fine-grained events, but they struggle on interaction and intervention tasks. Open-source causal streaming VideoLLMs perform even worse in the reported comparisons. The key behavioral finding is over-response: when offline MLLMs are deployed in a streaming setting, they often flood the output stream with repetitive or unprompted predictions. Post-training with a silence objective reduces false positives, but it also increases false negatives, making models less responsive. Timeliness-F1 exposes this trade-off because it scores the full stream rather than isolated pause points. AsynKV serves as a strong no-training baseline by reducing repeated responses and improving memory use during idle intervals.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is sufficient. Start with the task design and compare detection, interaction, and intervention. Then read the Timeliness-F1 definition, since it is the main methodological contribution and explains why older protocols miss over-response and delayed response. In the experiments, focus on the behavioral diagnosis of offline MLLMs, the false-positive versus false-negative trade-off from silence training, and the AsynKV ablations if available. Researchers interested in serving or long-video memory should read the AsynKV section more carefully; the motivating application examples can be skimmed quickly.

recommendation.zh: 看 metric 定义和 dead-time 分析；它会提醒流式 VLM 训练不能只优化回答，还要显式训练不回答。
recommendation.en: Read the metric definition and dead-time analysis; it shows that streaming VLM training must optimize silence, not just answers.

paper.title: Beyond Single Plots: A Benchmark for Question Answering on Multi-Charts
paper.abstract: Charts are widely used to present complex information. Deriving meaningful insights in real-world contexts often requires interpreting multiple related charts together. Research on understanding multi-chart images has not been extensively explored. We introduce PolyChartQA, a mid-scale dataset specifically designed for question answering over multi-chart images. PolyChartQA comprises 534 multi-chart images (with a total of 2,297 sub-charts) sourced from peer-reviewed computer science research pu

summary.core_problem: 解决现有 chart QA 主要停留在单图场景、无法衡量多图联合理解能力的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型主要是 benchmark/data。对做原生多模态预训练的人有一点参考价值，因为它暴露了现有 MLLM 在跨图结构组合、真实人工问题上的明显短板，但不直接提出新的预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PolyChartQA，多图表问答数据集，包含来自计算机科学论文的 534 张 multi-chart 图像、共 2,297 个子图和 2,694 个 QA 对；并设计按问题类型、难度、问题来源和图表结构特征的细粒度评测，同时给出一个 prompting 改进。
summary.experiments: 评测了 9 个现有多模态语言模型。关键结果是：在人类撰写问题上，相比模型生成问题，准确率下降 27.4%；作者的 prompting 方法带来 5.39% 的 L-Accuracy 提升。数据规模中等，结论更适合作为能力缺口诊断，而非训练结论。
summary.authors_note: Iowa State University。工作是多图表理解 benchmark，适合做 VLM 评测集补充，但不是范式级多模态预训练研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of evaluation for question answering over multiple related charts, beyond the standard single-chart setting.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a benchmark/dataset. It has some value for native multimodal pretraining researchers because it exposes clear weaknesses of current MLLMs on cross-chart composition and human-authored questions, but it does not introduce a new pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces PolyChartQA, a multi-chart QA dataset with 534 multi-chart images from computer science papers, 2,297 sub-charts, and 2,694 QA pairs. The benchmark supports fine-grained analysis by question type, difficulty, source, and structural chart properties, and includes a prompting improvement.
summary_en.experiments: Nine state-of-the-art multimodal language models are evaluated. The key findings are a 27.4% accuracy drop on human-authored questions relative to model-generated ones, and a 5.39% L-Accuracy gain from the proposed prompting method. The dataset is mid-scale and more diagnostic than training-oriented.
summary_en.authors_note: Iowa State University. This is a benchmark for multi-chart understanding, useful as an additional VLM evaluation set but not a paradigm-level multimodal pretraining paper.

recommendation.zh: 不是训练论文，但可当 VLM 诊断集备查；只看数据构成和 human-vs-synthetic 的 27.4% gap，能提醒你别拿合成题高估模型。
recommendation.en: Not a training paper, but a useful VLM diagnostic benchmark; just read the dataset design and the 27.4% human-vs-synthetic gap to avoid overestimating models on synthetic QA.

paper.title: Seeing Isn't Believing: Uncovering Blind Spots in Evaluator Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate outputs of other models, for image-to-text (I2T) tasks such as visual question answering, and text-to-image (T2I) generation tasks. Despite this growing reliance, the reliability of these Evaluator VLMs remains under explored. In this work, we systematically evaluate the reliability of Evaluator VLMs across both I2T and T2I tasks. We introduce targeted perturbations that degrade output quality along key error dimensions, inclu

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究把 VLM 当评审器时是否可靠，尤其是在图文理解和图像生成评测中，评审模型能否识别对象幻觉、空间关系错误、事实失真和视觉质量下降等关键缺陷。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是评测与失效分析，而不是新模型。它补上了一个常被默认但很少被系统验证的前提：用 VLM 评估别的模型输出并不天然可靠。对做多模态训练和自动化评测的人，这类 blind spot 会直接影响数据筛选、reward 建模和 benchmark 结论。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构造了一个面向 evaluator VLM 的定向扰动基准，在 I2T 和 T2I 两类任务上，沿 40 个扰动维度生成 4000+ 个质量退化样本。然后用单答案打分、成对比较、参考引导三种常见评测范式，系统测试 4 个主流 VLM 评审器是否会对这些错误给出一致且敏感的惩罚。
summary.experiments: 实验规模为 4000+ 扰动样本、40 个扰动维度、4 个 evaluator VLM，覆盖 I2T 与 T2I 两类场景。摘要给出的核心结论是：当前 VLM 评审器存在显著盲点，对若干关键错误维度不敏感，且不同评测范式下稳定性有限。论文更像 benchmark+failure analysis，未见大规模训练或新 SOTA 主张。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 AI4Bharat / IIT Madras。Mitesh M. Khapra 在印度 NLP/多模态社区有较高知名度，团队长期做语言技术与评测。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper asks whether VLMs used as evaluators are actually reliable, especially for detecting object hallucination, spatial mistakes, factual grounding errors, and visual quality degradation in I2T and T2I evaluation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is primarily benchmark and failure analysis rather than a new model. It challenges a widely assumed premise: using VLMs as judges is not automatically trustworthy. This matters for multimodal training, data filtering, reward modeling, and benchmark interpretation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a targeted perturbation benchmark for evaluator VLMs. Across I2T and T2I tasks, they generate over 4,000 degraded instances spanning 40 perturbation dimensions. They then test four prominent VLM evaluators under three common evaluation paradigms: single-score grading, pairwise comparison, and reference-guided assessment.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers 4,000+ perturbed instances, 40 perturbation dimensions, and four evaluator VLMs across both I2T and T2I settings. The main finding from the abstract is that current evaluator VLMs have substantial blind spots and are often insensitive to important error types, with limited robustness across evaluation protocols. This is a benchmark/failure-analysis paper, not a large-scale training or SOTA paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from AI4Bharat and IIT Madras. Mitesh M. Khapra is a well-known researcher in NLP and multimodal learning, and the group has a strong track record in language technology and evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 做多模态自动评测或 reward 建模的人可以看，但对基座预训练只算间接信号；重点看扰动设计和哪些错误维度最容易漏判，不必细读全文。
recommendation.en: Useful if you rely on VLM-as-a-judge or reward models, but only indirectly relevant to pretraining; read the perturbation taxonomy and failure tables, not the whole paper.

institutions: Nilekani Centre at AI4Bharat ♢Indian Institute of Technology Madras

paper.title: The Expense of Seeing: Attaining Trustworthy Multimodal Reasoning Within the Monolithic Paradigm
paper.abstract: The rapid proliferation of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) is widely celebrated as the dawn of unified multimodal knowledge discovery but its foundation operates on a dangerous, unquestioned axiom: that current VLMs faithfully synthesise multimodal data. We argue they do not. Instead, a profound crisis of trustworthiness underlies the dominant Vision Encoder-Projector-LLM paradigm. Rather than extracting grounded knowledge from visual inputs, state-of-the-art models frequently exhibit functional b

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是单体式 VLM 范式里一个更偏诊断的问题：Vision Encoder + Projector + LLM 这条主流路线，到底有没有真正用到视觉信息，还是主要靠语言先验在“猜”。作者把这个问题称为 trustworthiness crisis，核心不是再证明一次数据集有偏，而是质疑现有多模态评测方法本身。很多工作通过去掉图像、比较 text-only 与 vision+text 的性能差来定义 multimodal gain 或 leakage，但作者认为这种 ablation-based 评测无法区分两件事：模型是否真的具备视觉整合能力，以及数据集是否允许模型靠文本偏置过关。论文要解决的是评测归因问题，也就是如何把“架构瓶颈”从“数据偏差”里剥离出来。
summary.importance: 对做多模态预训练的人，这篇文章的价值主要在问题设定和评测哲学，而不是给出一个成熟的新训练方法。它提醒了一件常被忽略的事：如果评测指标本身把数据缺失、信息删减、语言先验混在一起，那么你很难从 benchmark 分数反推模型的视觉表示是否足够好。这个判断对统一多模态建模很重要，因为很多架构改进最后都靠下游 benchmark 证明有效，但如果 benchmark 不能隔离视觉贡献，结论会很不稳。论文还明确批评了 Multimodal Gain 和 Multimodal Leakage 这类全局指标的局限，尤其指出 ML 的 max 形式会掩盖 alignment 训练对底座 LLM 推理能力的破坏。这个观察和 pretrain↔posttrain 接口也有关：多模态对齐不只是“加视觉能力”，也可能伤害原有语言能力。
summary.technical_approach:
从全文片段看，这篇工作更像一个诊断框架与评测立场的重构，而不是完整的模型方法论文。作者的技术主张主要有三部分。

第一，系统性批判现有 ablation-based 指标。作者讨论了 Multimodal Gain，定义为 vision+text 与 without-vision 的性能差；也讨论了 Multimodal Leakage，定义为 VLM 的 text-only 表现相对基座 LLM 的增益。作者指出 MG 的问题在于，它测的是“在删掉必要信息后，额外信号能补回多少”，而不是“模型是否忠实整合了视觉信息”。如果图像本来就是必要条件，那么去掉图像后的失败不能直接归因于架构缺陷。对 ML，作者进一步指出 max(0, S_wv - S_t) 这种定义会忽略 destructive interference：如果多模态对齐让 text-only 能力下降，现有指标不会把这种退化完整反映出来。

第二，作者提出要从全局平均指标转向 sample-level diagnostic criteria。也就是说，不再只看一个模型在整个数据集上的平均 gain，而是要对单样本判断：这个问题是否真的需要视觉、模型是否从视觉中提取了必要证据、视觉输入是否反而引入了噪声或误导。虽然给出的片段没有完整公式和最终实现细节，但论文的方向很明确：评测目标从“加了图像后分数有没有涨”转向“视觉是否在样本级别被忠实使用”。

第三，作者把问题上升到架构层面，认为 monolithic VEP-L 架构存在 representation bottleneck。也就是视觉编码器输出经过 projector 压缩后，进入 LLM 的视觉信息量和结构都可能不足，导致模型更愿意调用语言先验而不是做真实视觉推理。这个论点并不新，但作者试图把它从经验观察变成评测框架中的显式对象：不是用新 benchmark 去“碰运气”测出失败，而是设计能直接诊断视觉整合成本的标准。

从方法成熟度看，当前更像一篇立论型工作。它提出的问题是对的，批评也有道理，但是否形成了可复现、可广泛采用的评测协议，要看全文后半部分是否给出足够具体的诊断定义、标注流程和统计验证。若这些部分不足，这篇工作的影响会更多停留在观点层面。
summary.experiments:
从已给全文片段看，实验部分的细节还不完整，因此不能安全地编造具体数字。可以确认的实验意图有两点。

第一，作者试图证明现有数据消融式评测会把数据偏差误当成架构能力。也就是说，一个模型在 text-only 条件下表现好，不一定说明它发生了“泄漏”；也可能说明数据本身允许语言先验解题。反过来，vision+text 相对 text-only 的提升，也不等于模型完成了忠实的视觉整合。实验应当围绕这些归因错误展开，比较现有 MG/ML 指标与作者提出的诊断标准在样本级别上的差异。

第二，作者强调 destructive interference，即多模态对齐可能损伤底座 LLM 的原始推理能力。这意味着实验里大概率会比较 base LLM、对齐后的 VLM 在 text-only、vision+text、以及不同题型上的表现差异，展示现有 leakage 指标无法反映能力退化的情况。

如果你拿到全文，建议重点提取四类结果：一是作者到底评了哪些主流 VLM；二是 sample-level 诊断与 MG/ML 的相关性和分歧有多大；三是是否存在大量“视觉输入无贡献甚至有害”的样本；四是不同架构或不同 projector 设计是否表现出不同的 seeing expense。没有这些结果，这篇论文更像观点文章；有了这些结果，才会对多模态预训练评测形成实质影响。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合带着批判性去泛读。先看作者如何定义问题，再判断证据是否足够支撑这么强的结论。

建议先读 Introduction 和 Challenging Existing Assumptions 两节。这里集中给出了论文最重要的判断：现有多模态评测把数据偏差和架构瓶颈混在一起。然后直接看对 MG、ML 两个指标的数学批评，尤其是对 ML 中 max 结构的反驳，这部分是全文最清楚也最有信息量的地方。

接下来要看作者是否真的给出了可执行的新诊断框架。重点找 sample-level criterion 的正式定义、标注或判定流程、以及与现有 benchmark 的关系。如果这些内容只是概念描述，没有稳定协议和统计验证，阅读收益会明显下降。

实验部分不要先看总分，要先看案例分析和 failure taxonomy。因为这篇工作的价值不在“谁分高”，而在“为什么现有分数不可信”。若时间有限，20 到 30 分钟足够判断它是否只是立场文章。若你做 VLM 预训练或评测设计，再多花时间核对其诊断标准是否能落地到真实训练迭代中。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper focuses on a diagnosis problem inside the dominant monolithic VLM stack: do vision-encoder–projector–LLM systems actually use visual evidence, or do they often solve tasks by leaning on language priors? The authors frame this as a trustworthiness issue, but the sharper point is about evaluation. Much of current multimodal assessment relies on ablation: compare vision+text against text-only, then interpret the gap as multimodal gain or leakage. The paper argues that this setup cannot disentangle two different phenomena: dataset bias that allows text-only guessing, and architectural bottlenecks that prevent faithful visual integration. The core problem is therefore attribution in evaluation, not merely poor benchmark performance.
summary_en.importance: For multimodal pretraining research, the paper matters mainly as an evaluation critique rather than a new training recipe. Its main contribution is to question whether common metrics let us infer anything reliable about visual grounding quality. That matters because many architecture and alignment claims are validated through downstream benchmarks whose scores may not isolate the contribution of vision at all. The critique of Multimodal Gain and Multimodal Leakage is especially relevant. The paper points out that leakage metrics with a max operator can hide destructive interference, where multimodal alignment actually harms the base LLM’s text reasoning ability. That observation connects directly to the pretrain/post-train interface: adding multimodal alignment is not guaranteed to be monotonic in capability.
summary_en.technical_approach:
From the provided full-text excerpt, this is better understood as a diagnostic framework paper than as a model-method paper. The technical contribution has three parts.

First, it offers a formal critique of ablation-based multimodal metrics. Multimodal Gain is defined as the performance difference between vision+text and text-without-vision settings. The authors argue that this does not measure faithful integration; it measures how much an extra signal helps after information has been artificially removed. If the image is genuinely required, failure after deleting it cannot be cleanly attributed to an architectural weakness. For Multimodal Leakage, the paper argues that the common formulation with max(0, S_wv - S_t) is biased because it ignores destructive interference cases where multimodal alignment degrades the original text-only reasoning ability of the base LLM.

Second, the paper advocates moving from global average metrics to sample-level diagnostic criteria. The intended shift is from asking whether scores improve on average when images are added to asking, for each sample, whether the model actually extracted necessary evidence from vision, whether the visual input was indispensable, and whether vision introduced confusion rather than useful grounding. The excerpt does not include the full formalism, so the exact implementation details are unclear, but the conceptual move is explicit and central.

Third, the paper ties the evaluation problem back to architecture. It argues that the monolithic vision-encoder–projector–LLM pipeline suffers from a representation bottleneck: visual information is compressed through the projector before entering the LLM, which may encourage the model to default to strong language priors instead of performing grounded visual reasoning. The novelty is not the bottleneck claim itself, which has appeared before, but the attempt to make it the direct target of evaluation rather than an indirect post hoc explanation.

At its current level of detail, the work reads as a position-plus-framework paper. The critique is meaningful, but its practical impact depends on whether the later sections provide a reproducible protocol, concrete sample-level definitions, and convincing validation.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental details are not fully available in the provided excerpt, so exact numbers should not be asserted. Still, the intended empirical story is clear.

First, the authors aim to show that ablation-based evaluation confounds dataset bias with architectural capability. Strong text-only performance does not necessarily imply leakage in the architectural sense; it may simply mean the dataset can be solved from textual priors. Conversely, a positive vision+text minus text-only gap does not prove faithful multimodal synthesis. The experiments are therefore expected to compare standard MG/ML-style conclusions against the paper’s sample-level diagnostics and show disagreement in attribution.

Second, the paper emphasizes destructive interference: multimodal alignment may damage the base LLM’s original reasoning ability. That suggests experiments comparing the base LLM and the aligned VLM under text-only and multimodal settings, ideally broken down by task type, to demonstrate cases that standard leakage metrics fail to capture.

If reading the full paper, extract four things carefully: which VLMs are evaluated, how strongly the proposed sample-level diagnostics diverge from MG/ML, how often visual input is non-contributory or harmful, and whether different projector or architecture choices change the measured “expense of seeing.” Without those results, the paper remains mostly a critique. With them, it becomes much more relevant for multimodal pretraining evaluation.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this one with some skepticism and focus on whether the evidence matches the strength of the claims.

Start with the introduction and the section critiquing existing assumptions. Those parts contain the clearest and most useful argument: current multimodal evaluation often mixes dataset bias with architectural bottlenecks. Then inspect the mathematical criticism of MG and ML, especially the discussion of the max operator in leakage metrics. That is the most concrete part of the paper.

After that, check whether the paper actually delivers an operational alternative. Look for a formal definition of the sample-level diagnostic criterion, the annotation or decision procedure, and how it is validated. If these are only described conceptually, the paper is more of a position statement than a deployable evaluation method.

In the experiments, do not start from leaderboard-style aggregate scores. Start from case studies, failure taxonomy, and disagreement analysis with existing metrics. The value of the paper lies in explaining why current scores can be misleading, not in producing another ranking. A 20–30 minute skim is enough to judge whether it offers a usable protocol. If you work on VLM pretraining or evaluation design, spend extra time checking whether the proposed diagnostics can be integrated into real model iteration loops.

recommendation.zh: 这类论文常有论证过度的问题，但如果 protocol 控制得干净，它会直接影响你怎么看 projector-style VLM；先看方法设定和 failure case，别先信结论。
recommendation.en: These papers often overclaim, but if the protocol is clean it materially changes how you view projector-style VLMs; read the setup and failure cases before buying the thesis.

paper.title: Beyond Perception Errors: Semantic Fixation in Large Vision-Language Models

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM评测常把错误混在一起：到底是“看错了”（perception error）还是“语义/规则映射错了”（rule-mapping error）难以区分。本文提出并刻画一种更纯粹的失败模式——semantic fixation：即在视觉状态完全相同的情况下，模型仍固守预训练中更常见的语义解释（标准规则），无法按提示完成等价但相反的规则映射（逆规则/misère-style）。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的启发主要是机制与后训练交互：1）它提供了一个控制变量极强的诊断基准VLM-Fix，把“语义先验压倒指令”的现象从感知因素中剥离出来，可用于分析预训练语料分布偏置如何在推理时表现为语义锚定；2）它显示SFT/RLVR等后训练会产生强规则对齐但带来跨规则负迁移，提示后训练可能加剧某些语义通道的‘单一读出’；3）late-layer steering能部分修复，暗示错误更多发生在后层语义读出而非视觉表征本身，这对研究‘预训练表征 vs 对齐读出层’的分工很有价值。
summary.technical_approach:
1）VLM-Fix基准：选四个抽象棋类（井字棋、四子棋、黑白棋、点格棋），生成终局盘面；对同一终局盘面构造标准规则与逆规则两种语义解释，并分别询问winner/loser，从而在“视觉证据完全一致”下只改变语义映射。
2）三种渲染控制感知：Base/Checkerboard/Glyph（把棋子符号替换为随机字母glyph）用于降低模型对熟悉外观的捷径。
3）提示词干预验证机制：用neutral alias（中性标签）替换winner/loser等带强语义价的词，能显著缩小逆规则差距；再用带语义价的别名又会重新拉开差距，支持‘语义框架触发固着’的解释。
4）后训练分析：比较SFT与RLVR在单规则训练 vs 联合规则训练下的同规则提升与跨规则迁移；并用后层激活steering在推理时纠偏，定位问题更偏后层读出。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖14个开源与闭源VLM，在VLM-Fix上普遍出现：标准规则准确率显著高于逆规则（semantic-fixation gap），且该差距在不同游戏、不同渲染风格下保持一致趋势。提示词实验显示：neutral alias能显著缩小gap，语义化alias会恢复gap。后训练实验显示：只在一种规则上做SFT/RLVR会提升同规则但损害对立规则（负迁移）；联合规则训练能改善双规则泛化。late-layer activation steering可部分恢复逆规则性能。另在VLMBias的counterfactual counting任务上观察到相似定性趋势。
注：你提供的全文片段未包含各模型的具体准确率数字、gap幅度、训练样本量与steering强度等表格，因此无法给出精确数值复盘。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约25-35分钟）：
- 先读Dataset/Evaluation设置：理解“同一终局盘面+规则翻转”的控制变量设计，这是论文最核心贡献。
- 再看Prompt families与alias干预实验（通常配Figure 1）：这是证明semantic fixation机制的关键证据链。
- 最后看后训练与steering部分：关注‘单规则对齐→跨规则负迁移’这一结论，以及作者如何据此推断问题在late semantic readout。
如果你的目标是预训练数据/分布研究：建议把标准规则更常见这一点视作“预训练频次先验”，思考如何用数据再加权/反事实数据合成在预训练阶段缓解。

summary_en.core_problem: Many VLM failures conflate perception mistakes with semantic/rule-mapping mistakes. This paper isolates a distinct failure mode—semantic fixation—where a model sticks to a default, familiar interpretation (standard rules) even when the prompt specifies an alternative but equally valid mapping (inverse rules), under identical visual evidence.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model research, the value is diagnostic and mechanistic: VLM-Fix cleanly factors out perception by holding terminal board states constant while flipping semantics, making it a sharp probe of pretraining priors and instruction-overriding biases. It also shows post-training tradeoffs: SFT/RLVR can be strongly rule-aligned yet induce negative transfer across rules, while joint training improves generalization. Late-layer activation steering partially fixes inverse-rule errors, suggesting the issue is often in late semantic readout rather than visual recognition—useful for separating representation vs alignment/readout effects.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces VLM-Fix across four abstract games (Tic-Tac-Toe, Connect Four, Reversi, Dots and Boxes). For each terminal board state, it evaluates paired prompts under standard vs inverse (misère-style) rules, and asks both winner and loser queries. Visual confounds are controlled via three render styles (Base, Checkerboard, Glyph with randomized symbols). Mechanism tests use prompt interventions: replacing winner/loser with neutral aliases reduces the inverse-rule gap; reintroducing semantic valence reopens it. Post-training analysis compares single-rule vs joint-rule SFT and RLVR, and uses late-layer activation steering to recover some inverse-rule performance, localizing the failure to late semantic decoding.
summary_en.experiments:
Across 14 open and closed VLMs, accuracy is consistently higher for standard rules than inverse rules on identical visual states, yielding a robust semantic-fixation gap across games and render styles. Neutral-alias prompting narrows the gap; semantically loaded aliases restore it. Post-training on one rule improves same-rule performance but hurts cross-rule transfer; joint rule training improves performance on both. Late-layer steering partially recovers degraded inverse-rule accuracy. Similar qualitative behavior is reported on VLMBias (counterfactual counting), supporting external validity.
Caveat: the provided full-text excerpt does not include the numeric tables (exact accuracies/gap sizes, training set sizes, steering parameters), so precise figures cannot be quoted from the given content.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~25–35 min):
1) Read the dataset/evaluation section to internalize the controlled paired-design (same terminal state, flipped semantics).
2) Focus on the prompt-family and alias intervention results (often centered around Fig. 1) as the main causal evidence for semantic fixation.
3) Then read the post-training and activation-steering sections for the negative-transfer finding and the late-readout hypothesis.
If your interest is pretraining/data priors, treat “standard rules are more frequent in web data” as an explicit frequency-prior hypothesis and consider how counterfactual data mixing or reweighting might mitigate fixation.

recommendation.zh: VLM-Fix 控变量很干净，把错误从感知里剥离成“语义锚定”，还能看到后训练的负迁移；只看基准构造与 late-layer steering 结果。
recommendation.en: VLM-Fix is unusually clean in isolating “semantic fixation” from perception, and it exposes post-training negative transfer; skim benchmark construction and late-layer steering results.

paper.title: GlotOCR Bench: OCR Models Still Struggle Beyond a Handful of Unicode Scripts

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM/OCR系统在多Unicode文字体系上的泛化评测缺失，导致“看似能OCR”但实际只覆盖少数脚本的问题难以被系统性暴露与量化。
summary.importance: 贡献了覆盖100+ Unicode脚本的OCR泛化benchmark，并用系统评测揭示：多数模型只在少数脚本上可靠，性能与预训练覆盖强相关；对多语种/多脚本数据配比与多模态预训练覆盖具有直接诊断价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建GlotOCR Bench：从真实多语文本渲染生成图像，使用Google Fonts字体、HarfBuzz排版、FreeType栅格化，包含干净/退化两种图像变体；抽样人工核验渲染正确性；评测开源与闭源VLM/OCR模型在不同脚本上的识别能力，并分析与脚本级预训练覆盖的相关性。
summary.experiments: 评测对象包含多种开源权重与专有前沿VLM；主要结论是：多数模型在少于10种脚本上表现好，最强模型也难超过30种脚本的可靠泛化；退化图像进一步放大差距；并观察到性能随脚本预训练覆盖度变化的趋势（摘要未给出具体模型规模与绝对指标细节）。

summary_en.core_problem: OCR evaluation for modern VLM-based systems is heavily biased toward a small set of scripts, making cross-script generalization failures hard to measure and diagnose.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a 100+ Unicode-script OCR generalization benchmark and shows that most models only work reliably on a handful of scripts; performance correlates with script-level pretraining coverage, providing actionable signals for multilingual/multiscript multimodal pretraining and data mixing.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds GlotOCR Bench by rendering images from real multilingual texts using Google Fonts, HarfBuzz shaping, and FreeType rasterization, with both clean and degraded variants; manually validates rendering on sampled images; evaluates a range of open and proprietary VLM/OCR models and analyzes script coverage effects.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates multiple open-weight and closed models; finds most perform well on <10 scripts and even frontier models fail to generalize beyond ~30 scripts; degraded images worsen gaps; the abstract does not specify model sizes or full metric tables.

recommendation.zh: 知道这个 benchmark 就够：它会让你在多脚本 OCR 上不再自欺；对预训练的直接 action 是回头查语料脚本覆盖与采样权重，正文无需细读。
recommendation.en: Glance-worthy as a benchmark sanity check: it prevents self-deception on multi-script OCR; the actionable takeaway is auditing script coverage and sampling weights in pretraining—no need to read deeply.

paper.title: Do Thought Streams Matter? Evaluating Reasoning in Gemini Vision-Language Models for Video Scene Understanding

summary.core_problem: 在视频场景理解的VLM中，显式“思考/推理痕迹”（thought streams）是否真的带来质量提升、提升在何处饱和、以及模型在思考中关注了什么。
summary.importance: 面向VLM推理过程的评测与分析工作：量化“更多思考token是否更好”及其边际收益，对推理预算、可解释性评测、以及推理时计算分配具有直接启发；属于有价值的VLM评测/机制分析交叉。
summary.technical_approach: 基于Gemini 2.5 Flash/Flash Lite多配置，提出三类指标：Contentfulness（思考内容有效性）、Thought-Final Coverage（思考到最终回答的一致性/覆盖）、Dominant Entity Analysis（关注实体/动作/场景的分布）；使用GPT-5作为独立裁判进行评估。
summary.experiments: 在约100小时视频抽取的场景上评测4种Gemini配置；主要发现为额外思考带来的质量增益很快饱和（多数提升在前几百token），Flash Lite在质量与token开销间更均衡；摘要未给出具体分数提升幅度与统计显著性细节。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper evaluates whether producing explicit intermediate “thought streams” improves video scene understanding in Gemini vision-language models, where the gains saturate, and what the models attend to during such reasoning traces.
summary_en.importance: It provides an evaluation and analysis of reasoning-budget tradeoffs—quantifying whether more reasoning tokens actually help and with diminishing returns—informing interpretability assessments and compute allocation for multimodal video understanding.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using multiple configurations of Gemini 2.5 Flash and Flash Lite, the authors define three analysis metrics: Contentfulness (usefulness of the thought content), Thought–Final Coverage (consistency/coverage between thoughts and final answers), and Dominant Entity Analysis (distribution of attended entities/actions/scenes); they use GPT-5 as an external judge to score and analyze outputs.
summary_en.experiments: On video-scene tasks derived from roughly 100 hours of video and across four Gemini configurations, the study finds that quality improvements from additional thought tokens saturate quickly (most gains within the first few hundred tokens) and that Flash Lite offers a better quality–token tradeoff; the abstract omits exact effect sizes and significance details.

recommendation.zh: 告诉你“多吐思考token”在视频VLM里收益何时饱和，适合做推理预算策略但与预训练关联弱；只看思考长度-性能曲线和失败案例分析。
recommendation.en: It quantifies when extra ‘thought stream’ tokens saturate for video VLMs—useful for inference-budget policy, less for pretraining; skim the length-vs-performance curves and the failure analyses.

paper.title: PinpointQA: A Dataset and Benchmark for Small Object-Centric Spatial Understanding in Indoor Videos

summary.core_problem: 现有视频多模态模型缺乏对“室内视频中小物体的精确定位与可用空间表达”的直接评测，导致模型空间理解能力难以被诊断与推动。
summary.importance: 贡献类型为Benchmark/数据集：首次面向室内视频小物体中心的空间理解提出PinpointQA，覆盖从存在性判断到结构化空间预测的递进任务，有助于诊断VLM在细粒度空间指代、参照物选择与可执行位置表达上的短板。
summary.technical_approach: 基于ScanNet++与ScanNet200构建数据集，通过中间空间表示生成QA，设计四类任务：TPV（目标存在验证）、NRI（最近参照物识别）、FSD（细粒度空间描述）、SSP（结构化空间预测），强调“可用于下游”的精确位置表达而非泛化描述。
summary.experiments: 数据规模：1,024个场景、10,094个QA；任务覆盖四种难度递进设置；摘要未提供具体参评模型、baseline清单与SOTA/提升幅度细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Current video-language benchmarks insufficiently test precise localization and actionable spatial expression for small objects in indoor videos, limiting diagnosis and progress on fine-grained spatial understanding.
summary_en.importance: PinpointQA provides a dedicated dataset/benchmark centered on small-object spatial reasoning in indoor videos, with progressively harder tasks that expose weaknesses in fine-grained reference, landmark selection, and executable location descriptions.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built from ScanNet++ and ScanNet200, the dataset generates QA via intermediate spatial representations and defines four tasks: target presence verification (TPV), nearest reference identification (NRI), fine-grained spatial description (FSD), and structured spatial prediction (SSP), emphasizing precise, downstream-usable spatial outputs rather than generic descriptions.
summary_en.experiments: PinpointQA includes 1,024 scenes and 10,094 QA pairs spanning four difficulty levels/tasks; the abstract does not list evaluated models, baselines, or quantitative results.
